blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Egocentric human video offers a scalable source of manipulation priors for robot learning, yet translating raw data scale into generalizable robot policies demands rigorous data curation and training recipes. We introduce Open-HumanScale, the first fully open recipe for scaling egocentric pretraining to 50,000 hours, anchored by Open-HumanScale-50K---a curated egocentric video corpus densely annotated with hand motion and natural language. Leveraging this corpus, we systematically investigate pure human pretraining via closed-loop simulation evaluations and uncover an empirical log-linear scaling law linking pretraining data hours to downstream robot success rates. Grounded in these findings, we develop HumanWAM-Vanilla, a world--action model pretrained exclusively on 50k hours of egocentric human video. Upon robot post-training, HumanWAM-Vanilla reaches 92.08% success on RoboTwin 2.0 Clean2Clean and 68.88% on Clean2Random, alongside a 14.17% mean success rate and a 19.00 mean progress score on RoboDojo. To push the capability frontier further, we explore joint human--robot pretraining with HumanWAM-Goal, a visual-goal-conditioned world--action model. Hybrid data scaling unlocks broad zero-shot generalization across both simulation and physical benchmarks, propelling post-trained RoboTwin 2.0 performance to new state-of-the-art levels: 92.70% on Clean2Clean and a substantial leap to 84.60% on Clean2Random. On physical robots, HumanWAM-Goal further exhibits emergent embodied in-context learning, dynamically adapting its manipulation behavior to unseen visual goals without parameter updates. To support reproducible scaling research in embodied AI, we open-source the Open-HumanScale-50K corpus, data curation and pretraining pipelines, alongside the pretrained and post-trained HumanWAM checkpoints, inference code, and simulation evaluation suites.
blocks.zh: 爱果中心人类视频为机器人学习提供了可扩展的操纵前科来源,然而将原始数据尺度转化为通用的机器人政策则需要严格的数据校验和培训配方. 我们引入了开放人类尺度(Open-Human Scale),这是第一个将自我中心预训提升到5万小时的完全开放的秘方,它由开放人类尺度(Open-Human Scale-50K-)——一个用手动和自然语言加注的精致的自我中心视频集支撑. 利用这个工具 我们通过闭路模拟评估 系统调查纯人类的预训 并发现一个经验性的对数线缩放定律 将预训数据小时与下游机器人的成功率联系起来 基于这些发现,我们开发了HumanWAM-Vanilla,一种世界行动模型,它完全在50小时以自我为中心的人类视频上训练。 在机器人训练后,HumanWAM-Vanilla在RoboTwin 2.0 Clean2Clean上取得了92.08%的成功,在Clean2Random上取得了68.88%的成功,同时在RoboDojo上取得了14.17%的平均成功率和19.00的平均进步分. 为了进一步推动能力前沿,我们探索与HumanWAM-Goal进行人-机器人联合预训,这是一种具有视觉目标的世界行动模式。 混合数据缩放解开了广泛的零射一般化,包括模拟和物理基准,将经过训练的RoboTwin 2.0性能推进到新的最新水平:Clean2Clean上为92.70%,Clean2Random上为84.60%。 在物理机器人上,HumanWAM-Goal进一步展出包含在文字中的学习,动态地调整其操控行为以达到没有参数更新的看不见的视觉目标. 为了支持以人工智能形式进行可复制的推广研究,我们开放了开放的人类规模-50K程序、数据整理和预训管道,以及经过事先培训和后训练的人类WAM检查站、推论码和模拟评估套件。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Overview of Open-HumanScale. Using a curated 50,000-hour egocentric corpus, we show that scaling human data improves robot generalization after post-training, with greater task and scene diversity yielding steeper scaling curves. We then extend this pretraining approach to combine human and robot data, finding that hybrid scaling improves zero-shot success in simulation and across 20 real-world tasks.
blocks.zh: 图1:开放式人文框架概览。 我们用一个5万小时的自我中心工具, 显示人类数据的缩放可以改进机器人在训练后的一般化, 任务和场景多样性越大, 就会产生更陡峭的缩放曲线。 然后,我们把这种预训方法推广到结合人和机器人数据,发现混合缩放提高了模拟和20个现实世界任务中的零发成功.

blocks.en: Learning from human manipulation offers a scalable path toward general-purpose robot intelligence [ 22 , 73 , 33 ] . Robot foundation models require diverse manipulation experience to acquire skills that transfer across tasks and environments, but collecting this experience through teleoperation is costly [ 23 , 22 ] . Egocentric videos paired with hand-motion and language annotations offer a rich record of human interactions with objects across diverse scenes and tasks [ 20 , 43 ] . However, developing effective egocentric pretraining recipes that consistently improve downstream robot performance as data scale remains under investigation.
blocks.zh: 从人类操纵中学习,提供了通向通用机器人智能的可伸缩路径[22,73,33]. 机器人基础模型需要不同的操纵经验,才能获得跨任务和跨环境转移的技能,但通过远程操作收集这种经验需要花费[23,22]. 与手动和语言说明相配的爱高中心视频提供了丰富的人类与不同场景和任务的物体互动记录[20,43]. 然而,随着数据规模的扩大,开发出有效的以自我为中心的预先训练方法,不断提高下游机器人的性能,这一点仍在调查之中。

blocks.en: Previous work has demonstrated the value of human experience for robot learning. EgoScale [ 73 ] shows that large-scale human motion pretraining improves dexterous robot manipulation, while Being-H0.8 [ 4 ] extends egocentric pretraining to joint visual and tactile world modeling. HumanScale [ 33 ] further shows that, after robot post-training, validation action loss on held-out real-robot trajectories decreases log-linearly with egocentric pretraining hours. Dyna-2 [ 14 ] extends egocentric pretraining to one million hours and reports a scaling law in zero-shot robot action prediction, with corresponding improvements in robot task performance after post-training. These studies establish the empirical value of egocentric scaling, motivating further analysis of data diversity and the robot supervision required for downstream adaptation.
blocks.zh: 前作已经证明了人类经验对机器人学习的价值. Ego Scale [73] 显示大规模人类运动前期训练改进了狡猾的机器人操纵,而Being-H0.8 [4] 则将自我中心前期训练扩展到了联合视觉和触觉世界的建模. 人类规模[33]进一步显示,在机器人训练后,被搁置的实机器人轨迹上的验证动作损失随着以自我为中心的预训时间而减少日志线. Dyna-2 [14] 将以自我为中心的预训扩展至一百万小时,并在零镜头机器人动作预测中报告一个缩放定律,训练后机器人任务性能也有相应的改进. 这些研究确立了以自我为中心的规模化的经验价值,激励进一步分析数据多样性和下游适应所需的机器人监督.

blocks.en: We present Open-HumanScale , a fully open recipe for scaling egocentric pretraining for robot learning. Within a unified world–action model framework, we explore pretraining exclusively on 100 to 50,000 hours of human egocentric data, using a common robot post-training protocol and closed-loop simulation for controlled and reproducible comparisons of downstream robot task success. With curated data and a unified action representation, we observe an empirical log-linear scaling law relating pretraining hours to out-of-distribution success rates across two different attention configurations. Beyond duration, data diversity is a key scaling dimension, as expanding task and scene coverage alongside duration produces steeper scaling curves than increasing duration at fixed coverage. Larger-scale egocentric pretraining also improves the sample efficiency of robot adaptation, yielding higher success rates at matched demonstration budgets.
blocks.zh: 我们提出开放的人类规模, 一种完全开放的食谱, 在统一的世界行动模式框架内,我们探索专门对100至5万小时的以人类自负为中心的数据进行预训,使用通用的机器人训练后协议和闭路模拟,对下游机器人任务的成功进行可控和可复制的比较。 通过整理数据和统一行动说明,我们观察到一项经验性的对数线缩放法,将培训前时间与两种不同关注组合的分流成功率联系起来。 超过期限,数据多样性是一个关键的缩放层面,因为扩大任务和场景覆盖与持续时间相比,固定覆盖时间更长,会产生更陡峭的缩放曲线。 更大规模的以自我为中心的预训也提高了机器人适应的样本效率,在相匹配的示范预算上取得了更高的成功率.

blocks.en: Following this recipe, we develop HumanWAM-Vanilla , a vanilla world–action model pretrained exclusively on 50,000 hours of egocentric human data. After robot post-training, HumanWAM-Vanilla achieves 92.08% success on RoboTwin 2.0 [ 9 ] Clean2Clean and 68.88% on Clean2Random, together with a mean success rate of 14.17% and a mean progress score of 19.00 on RoboDojo [ 8 ] . The improvements extend to physical robots across multi-step, deformable-object, and long-horizon manipulation tasks. Under changes in tablecloth and lighting, mean success across four tasks increases from 2.5% without egocentric pretraining to 67.5% with HumanWAM-Vanilla, demonstrating stronger generalization.
blocks.zh: 根据这个配方,我们开发了HumanWAM-Vanilla, 一种香草世界行动模式, 完全依靠5万小时的以自负为中心的人类数据进行训练。 在机器人后训练后,HumanWAM-Vanilla在RoboTwin 2.0上取得了92.08%的成功[9] Clean2Clean和Clean2Random上取得了68.88%的成功,同时在RoboDojo上取得了14.17%的平均成功率和19.00的平均进步分[8]. 改进范围扩大到跨多步,可变形-对象,和长视距操纵任务的物理机器人. 在桌布和照明的变化下,四个任务的成功率从2.5%(不以自我为中心的预先训练)增加到67.5%(HumanWAM-Vanilla),显示出更强的通俗化。

blocks.en:
To further push the model capability boundary, we extend our exploration to joint human-robot pretraining and propose HumanWAM-Goal , a world–action model with visual-goal conditioning. Human data provide broad manipulation experience, while robot data ground this experience in embodiment-specific perception and control [ 73 , 25 ] . Visual goals specify desired object configurations and spatial relationships, providing task context for zero-shot execution.
With the specially designed unified action representation, HumanWAM-Goal architecture, and the hybrid training recipe, the co-trained model supports out-of-the-box execution without parameter updates during deployment.
We evaluate data scaling by expanding the robot corpus and the human data. The performance scaling trend persists in this hybrid data setting. On physical robots, adding 45.9k hours of human data to a fixed 14.6k-hour robot corpus increases mean zero-shot success across 20 tasks from 20.0% to 30.5%. On RoboTwin 2.0, HumanWAM-Goal achieves 13.94% mean zero-shot success rate. After post-training, it reaches 92.70% on Clean2Clean and 84.60% on Clean2Random, yielding a state-of-the-art average success rate of 88.65% on RoboTwin 2.0.
blocks.zh:
为了进一步推进模型能力界限,我们把探索扩大到人类-机器人联合预训,并提议人类-机器人目标(HumanWAM-Goal),这是一个具有视觉-目标条件的世界行动模式。 人类数据提供广泛的操纵经验,而机器人数据则将这种经验建立在具体化的认知和控制[73,25]中. 视觉目标指定了所期望的对象配置和空间关系,为零发执行提供了任务上下文.
随着特别设计的统一动作代表,HumanWAM-Goal架构,以及混合训练配方,共同训练的模型支持在部署时没有参数更新的外出执行.
我们通过扩大机器人和人类数据来评估数据规模。 在这个混合数据设置中,业绩衡量趋势持续存在。 在物理机器人上,将45.9k小时的人类数据加到固定的14.6k小时机器人外壳上,意味着在20个任务中零发成功率从20.0%增加到30.5%。 在RoboTwin 2.0上,HumanWAM-Goal实现了13.94%的"零射入"成功率. 经过后期培训,在Clean2Clean上达到92.70%,在Clean2Random上达到84.60%,在RoboTwin 2.0上达到88.65%的最高平均成功率.

blocks.en: HumanWAM-Goal exhibits an emergent capacity for embodied in-context learning through visual goals. In real-robot experiments, the same policy adapts its execution to different desired outcomes specified by goal images without parameter updates. This capability is already present after joint pretraining and is retained when the model is post-trained for more complex, multi-step manipulation. Post-trained policies also follow goals depicted in egocentric human images, indicating that task-relevant spatial relationships can guide robot behavior across differences in embodiment and visual appearance.
blocks.zh: HumanWAM-目标展现出通过视觉目标进行内涵学习的新兴能力。 在真机器人实验中,同样的政策使其执行适应目标图像指定的不同预期结果而无需参数更新. 这种能力在经过联合预训后已经存在,在模型经过后期训练,进行更复杂的多步骤操纵时被保留. 训练后的政策也遵循以自我为中心的人类图像所描绘的目标,表明与任务相适应的空间关系可以指导机器人在表现和视觉外观上的不同行为.

blocks.en: To support reproducible scaling research in embodied AI, we open-source the Open-HumanScale-50K corpus, data curation and pretraining pipelines, alongside the pretrained and post-trained HumanWAM checkpoints, inference code, and simulation evaluation suites. Open-HumanScale-50K is a curated and aligned 50,000-hour egocentric pretraining corpus with hand-motion and language annotations, and our experiments demonstrate consistent gains in downstream robot generalization as pretraining on this corpus scales, with out-of-distribution success rates following an empirical log-linear scaling law.
blocks.zh: 为了支持以人工智能形式进行可复制的推广研究,我们开放了开放的人类规模-50K程序、数据整理和预训管道,以及经过事先培训和后训练的人类WAM检查站、推论码和模拟评估套件。 开放人类规模-50K是一个经过整理和调整的5万小时以自我为中心的预训课程,配有手动和语言说明,我们的实验显示,在下游机器人的通化中,作为本课程规模的预训,取得了持续的进展,在经验的对数线缩放法之后,分配率的成功率。

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are as follows: 1. A systematic study of egocentric scaling for robot generalization. We present Open-HumanScale, a fully open recipe for scaling pure egocentric pretraining from 100 to 50k hours. We identify an empirical log-linear scaling law in downstream robot task success rates and systematically analyze the benefits of egocentric scaling for robot generalization and adaptation. Building on this recipe, we develop HumanWAM-Vanilla, which achieves success rates of 92.08% on RoboTwin 2.0 Clean2Clean and 68.88% on Clean2Random after robot post-training, alongside competitive performance on RoboDojo. 2. Emerging robot capabilities through hybrid human–robot data scaling. With HumanWAM-Goal, we show that scaling joint human–robot pretraining improves zero-shot task execution in simulation and on physical robots. The model also exhibits embodied in-context learning, adapting its behavior to visual goals without parameter updates. After robot post-training, HumanWAM-Goal achieves a state-of-the-art average success rate of 88.65% on RoboTwin 2.0, with 92.70% on Clean2Clean and 84.60% on Clean2Random. 3. A full-stack release for reproducible scaling research. We provide the complete resources for reproducing our scaling studies and HumanWAM models. The release includes Open-HumanScale-50K, a curated and aligned 50k-hour egocentric corpus with hand-motion and language annotations, together with training code, model checkpoints and evaluation protocols.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献如下: 1. 系统研究以自我为中心的机器人通用规模。 我们提出一个开放的人类规模, 一个完全开放的食谱, 将纯粹的自我中心 预先训练从100至50小时。 我们确定了下游机器人任务成功率中的经验性日志线性缩放定律,并系统分析以自我为中心的缩放对于机器人通化和适应的好处. 基于这个配方,我们开发了HumanWAM-Vanilla,在RoboTwin 2.0 Clean2Clean上取得了92.08%的成功率,在机器人训练后Clean2Random上取得了68.88%的成功率,同时在RoboDojo上取得了竞争性能. 2. 通过人-机器人混合数据缩放,形成新的机器人能力。 通过HumanWAM-Goal,我们显示,扩大人类-机器人联合预训可以改进模拟和物理机器人的零射任务执行。 该模型还展现了包含在文字中的学习,使其行为适应没有参数更新的视觉目标. 在机器人后训练后,HumanWAM-Goal在RoboTwin 2.0上实现了88.65%的最高平均成功率,其中Clean2Clean上为92.70%,Clean2Random上为84.60%. 3. 用于可再生缩放研究的全装放出. 我们为复制我们的规模研究和人类水机制模型提供了全部资源。 发行内容包括Open-Human Classicle-50K,这是一套用手动和语言说明来编订和调整50克时的自负中心体,以及培训守则、示范检查站和评价协议。

blocks.en: 2 Building an Open Egocentric Pretraining Corpus
blocks.zh: 2 建设开放的爱高中心预训公司

blocks.en: To support systematic scaling studies and large-scale egocentric pretraining, we build Open-HumanScale-50K , an open corpus from multiple publicly available egocentric datasets ( Figure 2 ). HumanNet [ 11 ] is the primary source, contributing egocentric videos collected from the internet and paired with hand-motion and language annotations. We curate manipulation sequences based on hand visibility, motion stability, and manipulation activity. To prepare these heterogeneous sources for joint pretraining, we map action annotations into a unified bimanual end-effector representation, aligning camera coordinates, wrist axes, and gripper openness across sources to provide a common action interface for subsequent robot adaptation.
blocks.zh: 为了支持系统规模研究和大规模自我中心预训,我们建立了开放人类规模-50K,这是一个公开的多种自我中心数据集的公开体(图2)。 HumanNet[11]是主要来源,提供从互联网上收集并配有手动和语言说明的以自我为中心的视频。 我们根据手的能见度 运动稳定性 和操纵活动来管理操纵序列 为了准备这些不同的来源进行联合预训,我们将动作说明映射成统一的双人终端效应表示,对相机坐标,手腕轴,以及各种来源的握手开口,为随后的机器人适应提供一个共同的动作界面.

blocks.en: 2.1 Pretraining Data Sources
blocks.zh: 2.1 预训数据来源

blocks.en:
To support systematic studies of egocentric scaling and large-scale model pretraining, we assemble a corpus of 50,000 hours of human manipulation video paired with language descriptions and hand-motion annotations. The corpus combines HumanNet, EgoSuite-Open100K, EgoDex, Gen-HumanEgo, and EgoVerse, which provide egocentric videos with accompanying hand-tracking annotations. Table 1 summarizes the data sources and their scales before and after curation. The corpus contains 31,396,799 physical episodes, which yield 35,934,235 continuous clips after curation, as individual episodes may be split into multiple retained segments.
The resulting 35.9 million clips cover a broad range of manipulation settings, including household, commercial service, and industrial environments.
blocks.zh:
为了支持系统研究以自我为中心的缩放和大规模模型预训,我们收集了50 000小时的人类操纵视频,配有语言描述和手动说明。 主体结合了"人文网","EgoSuite-Open100K","EgoDex","Gen-HumanEgo"和"EgoVerse",它们提供了以自负为中心并附有手履说明的视频. 表1汇总了整理前后的数据来源及其尺度。 教程包含31,396,799个物理分会,在曲后产生35,934,235个连续分会,因为个别分会被分会成多个保留分会.
所产生的3 590万个剪辑涉及广泛的操纵环境,包括家庭、商业服务和工业环境。

blocks.en: HumanNet [ 11 ] is a large-scale human-centric dataset combining one million hours of first- and third-person videos with language and motion annotations. We use an egocentric subset of internet videos covering manipulation, tool use, and multi-step activities across diverse objects and environments. These clips are accompanied by estimated 3D wrist poses, camera trajectories, and LLM-generated captions describing the observed activities and motions. After curation and corpus selection, we retain approximately 40,744 hours for pretraining.
blocks.zh: HumanNet [11]是一个以人为中心的大规模数据集,将100万小时第一人称和第三人称视频与语言和运动说明相融合. 我们使用一些以自我为中心的网络视频, 这些片段伴有估计的3D手腕姿势,相机轨迹,以及LLM生成的描述所观察到的活动和运动的字幕. 在挑选教程后,我们保留了大约40 744小时的预训时间。

blocks.en: EgoSuite-Open100K [ 75 ] is a large-scale egocentric human activity dataset. It provides head-mounted video synchronized with head-camera poses and tracked hand poses. Each sample includes 21 joint transforms per hand, episode-level task and scene labels, and time-stamped subtask descriptions. The hand annotations support wrist-pose extraction and the estimation of hand openness from fingertip distances, while the task and scene labels enable explicit coverage measurements. We retain 6,358 hours from EgoStandard and 724 hours from EgoPro.
blocks.zh: EgoSuite-Open100K [75]是一个以自负为中心的大规模人类活动数据集. 它提供头架相机与头相机相机和履带相机相同步的相机. 每个样本包括每只手21个联合变换,插曲级任务和场景标签,以及被打上时间戳的子任务描述. 手语说明支持从指尖相距取出手腕和估计手开口,而任务和场景标签则可以进行明确的覆盖度测量. 我们保留了6,358小时 从EgoStandard和724小时 从EgoPro。

blocks.en: EgoVerse [ 43 ] is a continuously expanding collection of egocentric human demonstrations contributed by academic and industrial partners. Its initial release comprises 1,362 hours spanning 1,965 tasks, 240 scenes, and 2,087 demonstrators, combining standardized tasks collected across laboratories with open-ended activities recorded in diverse environments. The data include 3D hand and head poses, camera poses, and language annotations, with fine-grained subtask descriptions for industry-contributed recordings. We use only a small subset of the Mecka source, retaining 24.81 hours after curation for Open-HumanScale-50K.
blocks.zh: EgoVerse[43]是学术和工业伙伴不断扩展的以自我为中心的人类示威的集合. 它最初的发布时间为1 362小时,涉及1 965个任务、240个场景和2 087个示威者,将各实验室收集的标准化任务与各种环境中记录的开放式活动结合起来。 数据包括3D手和头姿,相机姿势,和语言说明等,并附有细微的分任务描述,用于行业配乐. 我们只使用一个小子集 Mecka 源, 保留24.81小时后 为开放人类规模-50K。

blocks.en: Gen-HumanEgo [ 17 ] contains over 1,800 hours of human demonstrations across more than 10,000 tasks in domestic, commercial, industrial, and agricultural environments. The dataset provides 21 reconstructed 3D keypoints per hand, MANO [ 45 ] parameters, hand meshes, and depth maps. Hierarchical video-, task-, and subtask-level language annotations describe activities at different granularities, with temporal boundaries for tasks and subtasks.
blocks.zh: Gen-HumanEgo [17] 载有超过1,800小时的人类示威,涉及家庭、商业、工业和农业环境中的一万多起任务。 数据集提供每手重建21个3D键点,MANO [45]个参数,手接网,和深度地图. 分级视频-,任务-和子任务级别语言说明描述不同颗粒的活动,任务和子任务有时间界限.

blocks.en: EgoDex [ 20 ] contains 829 hours of egocentric human demonstrations covering 194 tabletop manipulation tasks. Collected with Apple Vision Pro, it focuses on active manipulation of everyday objects, including dexterous activities such as tying shoelaces and folding laundry. The dataset pairs 30 Hz RGB video with 3D head, upper-body, wrist, and finger poses, camera calibration, and natural-language task descriptions.
blocks.zh: EgoDex [20] 包含829小时以自我为中心的人类示威,涵盖194个平板电脑操纵任务. 与Apple Vision Pro相接而来,专注于积极操控日常物品,包括捆绑鞋带和折叠取衣等有德性的活动. 数据集对接了30个Hz RGB视频,有3D头,上身,手腕,和指相姿,相机校正,以及自然语言的任务描述.

blocks.en: 2.2 Data Curation
blocks.zh: 2.2 国家 数据校正

blocks.en: Effective large-scale pretraining depends on both corpus scale and supervision quality [ 66 , 34 ] . We curate egocentric recordings to retain active manipulation with clear visual context and temporally consistent motion annotations. These checks remove unreliable annotations and prolonged inactivity while retaining usable manipulation segments for pretraining.
blocks.zh: 有效的大规模预训取决于教程规模和监督质量[66、34]。 我们用清晰的视觉背景和时间上一致的动作说明来整理自我主义的录音,以保持积极的操纵。 这些检查删除了不可靠的说明和长时间的不活动,同时保留了可用于预训的操纵部分.

blocks.en: We assess hand visibility from action annotations to retain manipulation sequences with effective visual context. We project annotated 3D EEF positions into the image using camera calibration to determine whether each end effector lies within the field of view. When only one end effector is in view, we retain the sequence and restrict action supervision to the corresponding hand, excluding the other hand from both the action loss and normalization statistics. Internet videos may also contain incomplete hand views, with only fingers or a small portion of a hand visible near image boundaries, or excessively close views that limit the visible interaction context. We identify and filter these cases using EEF depth, projected scale, and the location and size of detected hand regions.
blocks.zh: 我们从动作说明中评估手能见度,以保留具有有效视觉背景的操纵序列. 我们利用相机校正将注解的3D EEF位置投放到图像中,以确定每个终端效应器是否位于视野内. 当只看到一个最终效应器时,我们保留了序列,并将行动监督限制在相应的方面,将另一方面排除在行动损失和正常化统计之外。 互联网视频也可能包含不完全的手取景,只有指或一小段手可以看见接近图像边界,或者过于接近的取景会限制可见的互动上下文. 我们使用EEF深度、预测规模以及检测到的手区域的位置和大小来识别和过滤这些病例。

blocks.en: Errors in estimated hand and camera poses can introduce abrupt jumps into manipulation trajectories. For EEF trajectories, we measure differences between original and smoothed positions, together with acceleration, jerk, and changes in position and orientation between adjacent frames. Camera trajectories are checked separately for abrupt pose changes and for excessive displacement or rotation relative to the pose at the start of each chunk. We remove frames that exceed any stability threshold and split sequences at those frames, retaining continuous segments for pretraining.
blocks.zh: 估计的手和相机姿势出现出错,会突然跳入操纵轨迹. 对于 EEF 轨迹,我们测量原始位置和平滑位置之间的差异,加上加速度,混蛋,以及相邻框架之间位置和方向的变化. 对相机轨迹进行单独检查,以了解每个块起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起 我们删除超过任何稳定性阈值的帧,并在这些帧上分出序列,保留连续段进行预训.

blocks.en: Long periods of inactivity introduce redundant static samples to the pretraining corpus. We measure EEF positional variation within 32-frame sliding windows and classify a window as inactive when this variation is at or below the motion threshold. We trim inactive portions from both ends of each chunk and discard chunks with fewer than 70% active windows.
blocks.zh: 长时间的不活动将多余的静态样本引入了预训书. 我们在32个框架的滑动窗口内测量EEF位置的变异,并在该变异处于运动阈值或低于运动阈值时将一个窗口归类为不活动. 我们从每个块的两端修剪不活动部分,并丢弃活动窗口不到70%的块。

blocks.en: 2.3 Unified Action Representation
blocks.zh: 2.3 联合行动代表

blocks.en: Joint pretraining on heterogeneous egocentric datasets requires consistent action supervision across sources. Although these datasets broaden the range of manipulation experience, their raw action data can encode similar physical motions differently, complicating the learning of shared visual–action relationships. We therefore align human trajectories and robot actions within a unified bimanual end-effector space. This alignment gives actions consistent geometric meaning across sources, allowing diverse demonstrations to contribute to a common action prediction objective.
blocks.zh: 联合对各种自我中心数据集进行预先培训,需要源头一致的行动监督。 虽然这些数据集拓宽了操纵经验的范围,但其原始动作数据可以不同地编码出类似的物理运动,使共同视觉-动作关系的学习复杂化. 因此,我们把人类的轨迹和机器人行动放在统一的双人终极效应空间内。 这种调整使各种来源的行动具有一致的几何意义,使各种演示能够有助于共同行动预测目标。

blocks.en: 3 Exploration of Pure Egocentric Data Scaling
blocks.zh: 3 探索纯爱中心 数据缩放

blocks.en: Egocentric data offer a promising route to scaling robot foundation models through abundant and diverse human manipulation experience. Prior work has investigated how pretraining exclusively on human egocentric data affects performance on downstream real-robot tasks [ 73 , 33 ] . However, scaling outcomes vary across pretraining recipes, with limited or inconsistent downstream generalization gains reported in other settings [ 56 , 50 ] . We first establish empirical scaling laws for egocentric pretraining with our proposed recipe, then examine data diversity and the sample efficiency of robot adaptation, and finally conduct controlled analyses of the pretraining and adaptation recipe.
blocks.zh: 以电子为中心的数据为通过丰富而多样的人类操纵经验来扩大机器人基础模型提供了一个有希望的途径. 先前的工作已经调查了专门以人类自负为中心的数据的预训如何影响下游真机器人任务的业绩[73,33]. 然而,在培训前的处方中,衡量结果各不相同,在其他环境中报告的下游普遍化进展有限或不一致[56、50]。 我们首先用我们提议的食谱来制定以自我为中心的先行训练的经验分级法则,然后审查数据的多样性和机器人改造的样本效率,最后对先行训练和后行调整的食谱进行有控制的分析.

blocks.zh: 问题7. 如何将单视自负中心预训扩大到多视机器人政策?

blocks.en: 3.1 Pretraining and Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 3.1 预训和评价议定书

blocks.en: To study scaling in pure egocentric pretraining, we adopt a unified world–action model backbone and a standardized training and evaluation pipeline ( Figure 3 ). After pretraining on human egocentric data, we adapt each model to RoboTwin 2.0 using clean demonstrations and measure its task success rate in closed-loop evaluation. Standardized tasks and success criteria, controlled environmental variation, and shared evaluation seeds support reproducible comparisons across pretraining scales and training settings. Evaluations within the demonstration distribution and under environmental randomization measure in-distribution performance and out-of-distribution generalization, respectively. Below, we describe the model architecture and the pretraining, robot post-training, and evaluation procedures.
blocks.zh: 为了研究如何扩大纯粹以自我为中心的先行训练,我们采用了统一的世界-行动模式主干线和标准化的培训与评价管道(图3)。 经过人类自我中心数据预训后,我们利用干净的演示,将每个模型调整为RoboTwin 2.0,并在闭路评估中测量其任务成功率. 标准化的任务和成功标准、可控制的环境变异和共享评价种子支持在培训前规模和培训环境中进行可复制的比较。 示范分布范围内的评价和环境随机化措施下分别进行分流性能和分流外通化评价. 下面我们描述模型架构和预训,机器人后训练,以及评价程序.

blocks.en: 3.1.1 Model.

Our experiments build on HumanWAM-Vanilla, a world–action model that jointly generates future video and actions from a single observation and a language instruction. The model extends Wan2.2-TI2V-5B [ 53 ] with an action expert that has the same depth as the video backbone, forming a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture. Following prior work [ 67 , 35 , 70 ] , we apply a widely used isolated attention mask in most experiments, allowing action tokens to attend to the first video frame but not to future video frames. During inference, the model can therefore omit future video generation and denoise only the action chunk, enabling fast policy execution. We use the unified 16-D bimanual end-effector action space defined in Section 2.3 and compute delta poses in the camera coordinate frame relative to the first-frame observation.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验基于HumanWAM-Vanilla, 一个世界行动模式, 该模型延伸了Wan2.2-TI2V-5B [53] 并配有与视频主干线深度相同的动作专家,组成了"变身"(Mixture-of-Transfers)架构. 在之前的工作[67,35,70]之后,我们在大多数实验中应用了被广泛使用的孤立的注意口罩,允许动作符去处理第一个视频帧,而不能处理未来的视频帧. 因此,在推论期间,该模型可以省略未来的视频生成,只保留动作块,从而能够快速地执行政策。 我们使用第2.3节所定义的统一的16-D双向终端效应动作空间,计算三角洲在相机坐标框中相对于第一帧观测所呈现的相机.

The training budget is adapted to the corpus size. blocks.en: 3.1.3 Post-training.

We post-train the pretrained model on RoboTwin 2.0 [ 9 ] , a bimanual tabletop benchmark with 50 tasks on the Aloha-AgileX embodiment. The model is post-trained on 50 clean demonstrations per task without data augmentation for 12k optimizer steps with a global batch size of 512, corresponding to approximately 10 epochs. For each pretraining run, we post-train checkpoints saved every 10k pretraining steps and evaluate the resulting policies in both clean and out-of-distribution settings, as described below, to track downstream performance and identify the best checkpoint for each corpus. We retain the single head-camera view from egocentric pretraining because introducing three camera views during post-training impairs the transfer of egocentric pretraining priors and head-camera images alone provide sufficient visual information to perform all RoboTwin tasks (see Section 3.8 ).
blocks.zh: 我们在RoboTwin 2.0 [9]上训练了预先训练过的模型,这是双人平面基准,在Aloha-AgileX上有50个任务. 该模型经过后期培训,每任务50个清洁演示,12克优化步骤没有数据增强,全球批量大小为512个,相当于大约10个纪元. 在每次训练前训练中,我们训练后检查站每节省10 000个训练前步骤,并评价在清洁和分配之外的情况下所产生的政策,如下文所述,以追踪下游的业绩并查明每个警察机关的最佳检查站。 我们保留以自我为中心的前期训练的单一相机视角,因为在后期训练中引入了三种相机视角,影响了自我中心前期训练的相机和相机图像的转移,仅靠这些相机就能提供足够的视觉信息来完成所有RoboTwin任务(见第3.8节)。

blocks.en: 3.1.4 Evaluation.

To assess how egocentric pretraining affects in-distribution performance and out-of-distribution generalization, we evaluate post-trained checkpoints under the clean, scene-ood, and random settings. Each checkpoint is rolled out on all 50 tasks with 50 episodes per task in each setting. Representative tasks and evaluation conditions are illustrated in Figure 4 . • clean : the training distribution, with the plain background, fixed lighting, no clutter, and fixed table height used to collect the demonstrations. • scene-ood : randomized backgrounds and tabletop textures, with all other conditions identical to clean. • random : the full RoboTwin randomization, with randomized backgrounds, table clutter, randomized lighting, and table-height jitter of up to 3 cm. Clean measures how well the policy fits the demonstration distribution, whereas scene-ood and random assess gains in downstream generalization from egocentric pretraining. Specifically, scene-ood focuses on robustness to visual scene variation. We find that the post-trained checkpoint with the best clean performance does not necessarily generalize best to randomized scenes. To examine pretraining gains in in-distribution performance and out-of-distribution generalization separately, we therefore report the success rate of the best checkpoint independently for each evaluation setting. To support fair comparisons and accelerate evaluation, we save expert-validated evaluation seeds and reuse them across evaluation rounds.
blocks.zh: 为了评估以自我为中心的预先训练如何影响分配业绩和分配外的一般化,我们评价在清洁、现场和随机设置下经过训练后的检查站。 每个检查站在所有50项任务上都推出,每起任务每起50次。 图4说明了代表性任务和评价条件。 清洁:培训分布,背景平坦,照明固定,没有杂乱无章,以及收集示威的固定桌高。 • 场景-ood:随机化的背景和平面纹理,所有其他条件与清洁相同。 • 随机:全RoboTwin随机化,有随机化背景,表盘相接,随机化照明,并有可长达3厘米的平面高强度活性. 清廉地衡量政策如何适合示范分发,而场景和随机评估下游普遍化从以自我为中心的预先训练中获得的收益。 具体地说,场景-wood注重强力到视觉场景变异. 我们发现,经过训练后、表现最佳的检查站不一定能将最佳的场景归纳为随机的场景。 为了分别审查分配业绩和分配外一般化的预先培训成果,我们因此报告每个评价环境的最佳检查站的成功率。 为了支持公平比较并加速评价,我们节省了经专家鉴定的评价种子,并在评价周期内重新使用。

blocks.en: 3.2 Scaling Egocentric Data from 100 to 50k Hours: What Improves?
blocks.zh: 3.2 将Egocentral数据从100k放大至50k 小时:有什么改进?

blocks.en: Whether and how scaling human data improves robot policy performance is a central question for robot foundation models. We investigate this question through a systematic study of egocentric pretraining from 100 to 50k hours. Under the same pretraining recipe, we find that scaling egocentric pretraining consistently improves downstream generalization across all three settings. We validate this trend under both isolated attention and inverse-dynamics (IDM) attention, which additionally allows action tokens to attend to future video.
blocks.zh: 人类数据的缩放是否以及如何提高机器人政策性能是机器人基础模型的核心问题. 我们通过对以自我为中心的100至50小时前训练的系统研究来调查这个问题。 根据同样的预训方法,我们发现,以自我为中心的预训不断改善下游对所有三种环境的普及。 在孤立的注意力和反向动力学(IDM)的注意力下,我们验证了这一趋势,这又使动作符号能够关注未来的视频.

blocks.en: We first examine scaling with isolated attention. Models are pretrained on 100, 500, 1,000, 5,000, and 10,000 hours of egocentric data, then post-trained and evaluated under a common downstream protocol. Figure 5 shows that scaling egocentric pretraining with isolated attention consistently improves downstream policy performance on RoboTwin. On clean, success increases from 71.2% at 100 hours to 80.0% at 10,000 hours, compared with 69.5% without egocentric pretraining. These gains indicate improved in-distribution performance under the same post-training protocol. The benefits are larger under distribution shift. From 100 to 10,000 hours, scene-ood success rises from 25.2% to 58.1%, while random success increases from 8.4% to 28.7%. Without egocentric pretraining, the corresponding success rates are only 16.2% and 2.1%.
blocks.zh: 我们首先以孤立的注意力审查规模。 模型在100,500,1000,5000,和一万小时的自负中心数据上进行预训,然后根据共同下游协议进行后培训和评估. 图5显示,在孤立关注下扩大以自我为中心的先行训练,不断改善RoboTwin的下游政策业绩。 在清洁方面,成功率从100小时的71.2%增加到了10 000小时的80.0%,而69.5%没有以自我为中心的预先训练。 这些成绩表明,根据同样的培训后协议,分配业绩有所改善。 在分配转变期间,效益更大。 从100到10000小时,场景成功率从25.2%上升到58.1%,而随机成功率则从8.4%上升到28.7%. 没有以自我为中心的预先训练,相应的成功率只有16.2%和2.1%。

Success rates increase across all three settings, with larger gains on scene-ood and random, indicating that scaling primarily strengthens generalization beyond the demonstration scenes.

Each tenfold increase in pretraining hours corresponds to fitted gains of 4.43 pp on clean, 15.88 pp on scene-ood, and 10.24 pp on random. These trends suggest that further scaling egocentric pretraining will continue to improve downstream policy performance, with particularly pronounced gains in out-of-distribution generalization.

blocks.en: Recent work motivates us to examine whether this scaling trend extends to architectures that condition actions on future visual information . We therefore validate the scaling experiments with inverse-dynamics attention and absolute camera-frame poses, allowing action tokens to attend to both current and future video frames. During training, action denoising is conditioned on the ground truth future video with noise augmentation. During inference, the model first generates future video latents and then predicts actions. This configuration substantially improves downstream performance, with detailed ablations examining the contributions of these design choices in Section 4.4 .
blocks.zh: 最近的工作促使我们审视这种规模化趋势是否延伸到那些将未来视觉信息作为行动条件的架构。 因此,我们通过反向动力学的注意和绝对相机框来验证缩放实验,使动作符号能够同时处理当前和未来视频框。 在训练期间,行动除声以现场真实性为条件,未来视频会增加噪音。 在推论期间,模型首先会生成未来的视频潜伏,然后预测动作. 这种配置大大地改善了下游的业绩,并在第4.4节详细审查了这些设计选择的贡献。

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Scaling egocentric pretraining with IDM attention strengthens downstream generalization. Clean success remains high across scales, while scene-ood and random success improve consistently. Blue dashed lines show log-linear scaling fits for the two out-of-distribution settings, with R 2 R^{2} reported in the corresponding panels. Gray dashed lines denote the baseline without egocentric pretraining.
blocks.zh: 图6: 增加以自我为中心的先行训练,同时重视国际数据管理,加强下游的普及。 各个尺度的清洁成功率仍然很高,而场景和随机成功率则不断提高。 蓝色破折线显示对数线缩放适合两个外分配设置,R 2 R^{2}在相应的面板上报告. 灰色折叠线表示基线,而不以自负为中心。

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 6 , clean success remains between 87.4% and 89.0% as egocentric pretraining scales from 100 to 50,000 hours. Even without egocentric pretraining, the model achieves 87.9% on clean, indicating strong in-distribution performance under IDM attention with absolute camera-frame poses. Scaling therefore yields only limited additional gains on the training distribution. The generalization gains are substantially larger. From 100 to 50,000 hours, scene-ood success increases from 49.1% to 73.2%, and random success rises from 21.5% to 42.9%, compared with 29.2% and 7.7% without egocentric pretraining. Improvements persist beyond 5,000 hours, where the corresponding success rates are 62.4% and 32.2%. Both out-of-distribution settings closely follow the empirical log-linear scaling law observed with isolated attention, with higher R 2 R^{2} values of 0.969 for scene-ood and 0.955 for random. This consistency across the two model configurations suggests that the generalization benefits of scaling egocentric pretraining extend beyond a specific attention design and action representation, even when in-distribution performance is already strong.
blocks.zh: 如图6所示,干净的成功率仍然在87.4%至89.0%之间,作为以自我为中心的100至5万小时前训练的尺度。 即使没有以自我为中心的预训,该模型在清洁上也取得了87.9%的成绩,表明在IDM关注下,具有绝对相机框外形的强大的分流性能. 因此,扩大培训在培训分配方面只产生有限的额外收益。 一般化的收益要大得多。 从100小时到50 000小时,场景成功率从49.1%上升到73.2%,随机成功率从21.5%上升到42.9%,而29.2%和7.7%没有自我中心预训. 改善持续到5 000小时以上,相应的成功率为62.4%和32.2%。 分布外设置都密切遵循了孤立地观察的经验性对数线缩放定律,较高的R 2 R^{2}值为:场景-ood为0.969,随机为0.955. 两种模式配置的这种一致性表明,规模化自我中心预训的通俗化好处超越了特定关注设计和动作表现,即使分配中的表现已经很强.

blocks.en: 3.3 Scaling Diversity, Not Just Hours
blocks.zh: 3.3 扩大多样性,而不仅仅是小时

blocks.en: Recent studies [ 73 , 33 , 14 ] have explored the scaling behavior of egocentric pretraining, with data duration as the primary scaling variable. Data diversity, including variation in tasks and scenes, is another important dimension of scaling embodied pretraining [ 27 , 47 ] . We investigate this dimension through controlled experiments on the EgoSuite-Open100K dataset with matched durations but varying task and scene coverage. Our results show that jointly scaling diversity and duration yields greater downstream gains than increasing duration alone.
blocks.zh: 最近的研究[73,33,14]探索了以自我为中心的先行训练的缩放行为,数据持续时间是主要的缩放变量. 数据多样性,包括任务和场景的差异,是规模化体现的预训的另一个重要方面[27,47]. 我们通过在EgoSuite-Open100K数据集上进行控制实验来调查这一维度,这些数据集有相应的持续时间,但任务和场景覆盖范围各不相同。 我们的结果表明,联合扩大多样性和持续时间,比仅仅延长持续时间就能产生更大的下游收益。

blocks.en: We construct two series of pretraining corpora at 100, 500, 1,000, and 5,000 hours from the EgoSuite-Open100K dataset. In the scaled-diversity series, task and scene coverage expands with data duration. In the matched-diversity series, the 100-, 500-, and 1,000-hour subsets cover the same set of tasks and scenes as the 5,000-hour parent corpus, so increasing duration adds trajectories within fixed task and scene coverage. At 100 hours, the matched-diversity corpus spans 2,288 tasks and 2,953 scenes, compared with 62 tasks and 222 scenes in the scaled-diversity corpus. For each corpus, we pretrain the model, apply the same post-training protocol, and evaluate success rates under all three settings.
blocks.zh: 我们从EgoSuite-Open100K数据集建造了两组预训阵型,时间分别为100,500,1000和5000小时. 在扩大的多样化系列中,任务和场景覆盖面随着数据的持续而扩大。 在相匹配多样性系列中,100-,500-和1000-小时子集涵盖了与5000-小时母体相同的一组任务和场景,因此不断延长的时间增加了固定任务和场景覆盖范围内的轨迹. 在100小时内,对应多样性法涉及2 288个任务和2 953个场景,而规模多样性法涉及62个任务和222个场景。 对于每份文书,我们先对模型进行培训,适用同样的培训后规程,并评估所有三种情况下的成功率。

blocks.en: Figure 7 shows that expanding diversity alongside duration produces steeper scaling slopes than increasing duration at fixed coverage. Relative to matched-diversity, scaled-diversity increases the fitted slopes by 2.02 on clean, 4.73 on scene-ood, and 4.50 on random, indicating greater performance gains as pretraining data scale. The larger slope increases on scene-ood and random suggest that diversity expansion particularly benefits downstream generalization. These results suggest a practical scaling rule for egocentric pretraining: jointly scaling diversity and duration yields greater performance gains than scaling duration alone.

blocks.en: 3.4 Scaling Egocentric Pretraining for Data-Efficient Robot Adaptation
blocks.zh: 3.4 增强数据有效机器人适应的以Egocentre预训

blocks.en: Generalization to new tasks and in-context learning have attracted growing interest in embodied pretraining [ 21 , 16 , 28 ] . In this section, we seek to explore how egocentric pretraining scale affects the sample efficiency of downstream robot policy adaptation.
blocks.zh: 对新任务的概括化和内容内学习,已引起人们对体现的预训[21、16、28]的日益关注。 在本节中,我们寻求探索以自我为中心的预训规模如何影响下游机器人政策适应的样本效率.

blocks.en: To assess how egocentric pretraining scale affects the sample efficiency of robot adaptation, we conduct post-training experiments with different initializations and demonstration budgets. We select the best-performing checkpoints from pretraining on 500 and 5,000 hours of egocentric data and compare them with a baseline without egocentric pretraining (No-Ego). For each initialization, separate post-training runs use 5, 10, 25, or 50 clean demonstrations per task.
blocks.zh: 为了评估以自我为中心的预训规模如何影响机器人改造的样本效率,我们用不同的初始化和演示预算进行训练后实验. 我们从500小时和5 000小时自我中心数据的预训中挑选出表现最好的检查站,并将其与基线进行比较,而不是自我中心预训(No-Ego)。 每次初始化时,单独的培训后运行使用5,10,25或50个清洁演示.

blocks.en: Figure 8 : Scaling egocentric pretraining improves the sample efficiency of robot adaptation. Success rates as a function of the number of robot demonstrations per task for different egocentric pretraining scales.
blocks.zh: 图8:增强以自我为中心的预训提高了机器人适应的样本效率. 成功率是每个任务的机器人演示次数的函数,用于不同的自负心前训练尺度.

blocks.en: Figure 8 shows a consistent scaling trend in post-training sample efficiency. Across all three settings, the 500-hour model outperforms No-Ego at every demonstration budget, with further gains from scaling to 5,000 hours. With 10 demonstrations per task, clean success increases from 34.5% for No-Ego to 44.2% after 500 hours of pretraining and 50.1% after 5,000 hours, indicating progressively more effective adaptation from limited robot demonstrations. At the same budget, scaling from 500 to 5,000 hours also approximately doubles random success, from 4.1% to 8.3%. The additional pretraining therefore improves both in-distribution performance and generalization without requiring more robot demonstrations.
blocks.zh: 图8显示培训后抽样效率的一致比例趋势。 在所有三种设置中,500小时模式在每一个示范预算中都优于 " 无Ego " 模式,并且从扩大至5 000小时有了进一步的收益。 每一次任务有10个演示,清洁成功率从"去Ego"的34.5%增加到了"500小时预训后"的44.2%和"5000小时后"的50.1%,表明通过有限的机器人演示逐渐提高适应效果. 在同一个预算中,从500小时增加到5 000小时,也大约是随机成功的两倍,从4.1%增加到8.3%。 因此,附加的预训既能改善分配性能,又能改善通用性能,而不需要更多的机器人演示.

blocks.en: These gains also lower demonstration requirements for comparable performance. On scene-ood, the No-Ego success rate with 50 demonstrations per task is exceeded by the 500-hour model with 25 demonstrations and by the 5,000-hour model with only 5. Further scaling from 500 to 5,000 hours continues to reduce dependence on robot demonstrations. With 25 demonstrations, the 5,000-hour model outperforms the 500-hour model trained on 50 demonstrations in both scene-ood (42.0% vs. 37.9%) and random (21.8% vs. 16.2%). This improvement establishes a clear scaling trend in post-training sample efficiency, with stronger generalization achieved using half the robot demonstrations.
blocks.zh: 这些收益还降低了对可比业绩的示范要求。 在现场-ood中,每个任务50个演示的"无Ego"成功率被25个演示的"500小时"模型和仅5个演示的"5000小时"模型所超越. 进一步从500小时扩大到5000小时,继续减少对机器人演示的依赖. 在25起示威中,5000小时的模型在50起示威中都超过了500小时的模型(42.0%对37.9%)和随机(21.8%对16.2%)。 这一改进在培训后样本效率方面确立了明显的规模化趋势,利用一半的机器人演示实现了更强的通缩.

blocks.en: 3.5 Does Cross-Source Action Alignment Matter?
blocks.zh: 3.5 跨来源行动对接是否重要?

blocks.en: Egocentric datasets obtain human action trajectories through different data collection and motion estimation pipelines, producing raw action data that lack a consistent physical interpretation across sources. Prior work incorporates geometric alignment to support learning from heterogeneous human and robot data [ 34 , 25 , 66 ] . We quantify the effect of camera-frame and wrist-axis alignment on pretraining loss and downstream policy performance under a fixed data mixture and training configuration.
blocks.zh: 爱高中心数据集通过不同的数据收集和运动估计管道获得人类行动轨迹,生成的原始行动数据缺乏不同来源之间一致的物理解释. 以前的工作包括几何校正,以支持从不同的人类和机器人数据中学习[34、25、66]。 我们量化照相机和腕轴相机对在固定数据组合和培训配置下预训损失和下游政策业绩的影响。

blocks.en: To evaluate the effect of cross-source action alignment, we construct a 1,000-hour corpus comprising EgoSuite-Open100K (593.7 h), HumanNet (250 h), EgoDex (114.5 h), and EgoVerse (41.8 h). We compare two models pretrained on identical clips and captions with the same sampling strategy, training schedule, and normalization procedure. In the Aligned setting, actions from each source are transformed into camera coordinates, and wrist axes are standardized to obtain a consistent action representation. In the Raw setting, actions from each source are used directly in their original representation.
blocks.zh: 为了评估跨源动作相接的效果,我们构建了一个由EgoSuite-Open100K(593.7h),HumanNet(250h),EgoDex(114.5h)和EgoVerse(41.8h)组成的1 000小时程序。 我们比较了两个在相同的片段和标题上预先培训过的模型,与同样的取样战略、培训时间表和正常化程序。 在"相通"设定中,来自每个源的行动被转化为相机坐标,手腕轴被标准化以获得一致的动作表示. 在 Raw 设置中,来自每个源的动作直接用于其原始表示.

blocks.en: Figure 9 : Cross-source action alignment improves downstream policy performance. Aligned and Raw models are pretrained on the same four-source 1,000-hour corpus using aligned and native action representations. Each point reports the best success rate across post-trained checkpoints for the corresponding pretraining run and evaluation setting. Gray dashed lines denote the baseline without egocentric pretraining.
blocks.zh: 图9:跨源行动相协调改善下游政策绩效. 结合模式和Raw模式在同一个4个来源的1 000小时程序书上经过预先培训,使用一致和本土的行动表述。 每个点都报告经过培训的检查站在相应的预训和评估设置方面的最佳成功率。 灰色折叠线表示基线,而不以自负为中心。

blocks.en: Figure 9 shows that Aligned outperforms Raw at every evaluated pretraining step across all three settings. Comparing the best checkpoints, clean success increases from 72.0% to 77.5% (+5.5 pp). The gains are larger under distribution shift, with scene-ood improving from 43.2% to 52.2% and random from 18.0% to 26.4%. Both pretrained models outperform the No-Ego baseline, showing that multi-source pretraining remains beneficial without alignment. Under the same data mixture and training protocol, cross-source action alignment further improves in-distribution performance and, more substantially, out-of-distribution generalization.
blocks.zh: 图9显示,业绩一致 在所有三个环境的每个评估前训练阶段都进行原始培训。 与最佳检查站相比,干净的成功率从72.0%增至77.5%(+5.5页)。 在分配转移期间,收益较大,场景改善率从43.2%增至52.2%,随机增加率从18.0%增至26.4%。 两个预先训练的模型都超过了"无Ego"基线,表明多源预训依然有益而无相通. 在同一数据混合和培训协议下,跨源动作相接进一步改善了分流性能,更大幅度地提高了分流外通化.

blocks.en: Figure 10 : Cross-source action alignment reduces pretraining action loss with little change in video loss. Curves show training losses for Aligned and Raw models on the same four-source 1,000-hour corpus.
blocks.zh: 图10:跨源动作相接减少了预训动作损失而视频损失几乎没有变化. 曲线显示Areating和Raw模型在同一种4源1000小时命题上的训练损失.

blocks.en: The effect of action alignment is also evident during pretraining ( Figure 10 ). Aligned exhibits lower action loss, while video loss remains comparable between the two models. These trends suggest that a well-aligned action representation provides more consistent supervision across sources and facilitates joint learning.
blocks.zh: 在培训前阶段,行动协调的效果也很明显(图10)。 相通显示动作损失较低,而视频损失在两种模型之间仍然具有可比性。 这些趋势表明,一种协调良好的行动代表制可提供更一致的跨来源监督并促进联合学习。

blocks.en: 3.6 Action Supervision in Egocentric Pretraining
blocks.zh: 3.6 以Egocentre Pretrain行动监督

blocks.en: Egocentric human data capture rich physical interactions in first-person videos paired with hand trajectories [ 20 , 43 ] . Whether to incorporate human motion prediction into world–action model pretraining remains an open question [ 50 , 7 , 35 , 59 ] . We show that jointly predicting human motion and future video substantially improves downstream policy generalization over video prediction alone on the same egocentric corpus.
blocks.zh: 爱高中心人类数据捕捉到第一人称视频中与手轨对接的丰富物理交互[20,43]. 是否将人类运动预测纳入世界 -- -- 行动模型预训仍然是一个有待解决的问题[50、7、35、59]。 我们显示,共同预测人类运动和未来视频将大大地改善下游政策一般化,而不是仅仅就同一自我中心因素进行视频预测。

blocks.en: We pretrain two models on the same 1,000-hour scaled-diversity corpus, with and without human motion prediction. For the video-only baseline, we set the action loss weight to zero and optimize video prediction alone. To assess the additional value of human motion targets, we train a second model with action loss enabled only for a fixed subset of original episodes covering approximately 50% of the total video duration. All models receive full robot action supervision during post-training, following Section 3.1 .
blocks.zh: 我们预先训练了两个模型 在同一个1000小时的 放大多样性, 有和没有人类运动预测。 对于只有视频的基线,我们把动作减重设定为零,并单独优化视频预测. 为了评估人类运动目标的额外价值,我们培训了第二个模型,其动作损失只能用于固定的一组原声片段,覆盖了视频总长度的大约50%。 所有型号在后期训练期间都接受完全的机器人动作监督,遵循第3.1节.

blocks.en: Figure 11 : Human action supervision during egocentric pretraining improves downstream generalization. Models are pretrained on the same 1,000-hour video corpus with 0%, 50%, or 100% human action supervision.
blocks.zh: 图11:以自我为中心的预训期间的人类行动监督改善了下游的普及。 模型在同一个1000小时的录像机上被预先训练,有0%,50%,或者100%的人的行动监督.

blocks.en: Figure 11 shows that learning human motion alongside video prediction consistently improves downstream robot policy performance across all three settings. At 20k pretraining steps, using motion targets for approximately 50% of the video duration increases clean success from 70.4% to 75.2% compared with video-only pretraining. The gains are larger under distribution shift, with scene-ood improving from 13.0% to 34.8% and random from 3.6% to 16.3%. The two objectives also exhibit distinct trends as pretraining progresses. From 10k to 30k steps, video-only performance remains nearly flat, with scene-ood and random success staying near 13% and 3%, respectively. Over the same interval, the model that jointly predicts human motion and future video improves steadily from 30.0% to 40.4% on scene-ood and from 12.3% to 20.1% on random. The widening gap indicates that human motion targets improve both performance at matched pretraining steps and the gains in downstream generalization from continued pretraining.
blocks.zh: 图11显示,学习人类运动和视频预测持续改善所有三种情况下下游机器人政策的表现。 在20克预训阶段,使用大约50%的视频持续时间的运动目标,与仅限视频预训相比,清洁成功率从70.4%提高到75.2%。 分配变化的收益较大,场景改善率从13.0%增至34.8%,随机增长率从3.6%增至16.3%。 随着培训前的进展,这两个目标也显示出不同的趋势。 从10k到30k步,只录相的性能仍然几乎平平,场景和随机的成功率分别保持在13%和3%. 在同一时间段内,共同预测人类运动和未来视频的模型在场景中稳步改善,从30.0%到40.4%,随机从12.3%到20.1%. 差距日益扩大表明,人类运动目标在相应预训阶段的性能以及持续预训在下游普及方面都有所改善。

blocks.en: 3.7 Can Egocentric Pretraining Surpass Robot Pretraining?
blocks.zh: 3.7 爱高中心 预训机器人预训?

blocks.en: Egocentric human data offer broader interaction coverage, greater scene diversity, and higher information density at lower collection cost than teleoperated robot data [ 33 ] . To assess their relative value for robot policy learning, HumanScale pretrained models on equal-duration egocentric or real-robot corpora, then post-trained each model on the same real-robot demonstrations. This comparison favored egocentric pretraining, which yielded lower validation action loss on held-out real-robot trajectories, particularly on tasks excluded from post-training. We extend this matched-scale comparison to closed-loop task success on RoboTwin to examine how the relative performance of the two pretraining sources varies with data scale.
blocks.zh: 爱高中心人类数据提供更广泛的交互覆盖范围,更大的场景多样性,以及比远程操作机器人数据的收集成本更低的信息密度[33]. 为了评估它们对机器人政策学习的相对价值,人类规模预先对以等期限自负为中心或以真机器人公司为中心的模型进行了训练,然后在同一个真机器人演示上对每个模型进行了后训练. 这种比较有利于自我中心化的预先训练,这导致对被扣留的实机器人轨迹进行较低的验证行动损失,特别是排除在培训后的任务。 我们在RoboTwin上将这种相匹配的尺度与闭路任务的成功进行对比,以审查两个预训来源的相对性能如何与数据尺度相去甚远.

blocks.en: We compare egocentric and real-robot pretraining at 100, 500, 1,000, and 5,000 hours. The egocentric series uses the scaled-diversity corpora in Figure 5 , while the real-robot series draws on AgiBot Beta [ 1 ] , ABC-130k [ 2 ] , and our in-house Cobot Magic data as shown in Table 4 . Both series use only head-camera observations during pretraining, given the effects of additional wrist-camera views discussed in Section 3.8 . We curate the robot corpora from language-annotated trajectories with verified head-camera extrinsics, excluding data with base or head-camera motion.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了以自我为中心的 真正的机器人预训 在100、500、1000和5000小时。 以自我为中心的系列在图5中使用了被缩放的相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 鉴于第3.8节所讨论到的额外手腕相机观点的影响,这两个系列在预训期间只使用头相机观测. 我们用经过验证的头相机外接器 将机器人蝎子从语言附加说明的轨迹中校正, 不包括有底部或头相机运动的数据。

blocks.zh: 表4:真机器人预训蝎子的构成.

blocks.en: Figure 12 : Egocentric pretraining outperforms robot pretraining from 500 to 5,000 hours. Downstream RoboTwin success rates after pretraining on 100, 500, 1,000, and 5,000 hours of egocentric human or robot data. The egocentric series follows the scaled-diversity configuration in Figure 5 . Each point reports the best post-training success rate among the evaluated pretraining checkpoints for that scale and setting.
blocks.zh: 图12:爱高中心预训优于机器人预训500至5000小时. 下游RoboTwin成功率在预训100,500,1000,以及5000小时以自负为中心的人或机器人数据后. 以自我为中心的系列遵循了图5中的规模多样性配置。 每个点都报告,在经过评估的、规模和设置的预先训练检查站中,培训后的成功率最好。

blocks.en: Figure 12 shows that egocentric pretraining outperforms robot pretraining in all three settings from 500 to 5,000 hours. At 100 hours, robot pretraining retains a small advantage on scene-ood and random, but this ordering reverses at larger scales. On clean, the egocentric advantage grows from 2.2 pp at 100 hours to 7.3 pp at 5,000 hours. At 5,000 hours, egocentric pretraining also achieves higher out-of-distribution success, reaching 52.3% versus 45.6% on scene-ood and 27.6% versus 22.4% on random. Its advantage therefore spans both in-distribution performance and robustness under distribution shift. The 1,000-hour egocentric model also outperforms the 5,000-hour robot model in all three settings, including scene-ood (48.2% versus 45.6%) and random (25.9% versus 22.4%). These comparisons extend the validation-loss evidence from HumanScale to closed-loop task success on RoboTwin, where egocentric pretraining yields stronger downstream policies despite the embodiment gap.
blocks.zh: 图12显示,以自我为中心的预先训练在所有三个场合的机器人预先训练超过500至5000小时。 在100时,机器人预训在场景和随机上保留了小优势,但这在更大的尺度上命令倒置. 在清洁方面,以自我为中心的优势从100小时的2.2页增加到了5 000小时的7.3页。 在5000小时,以自我为中心的预训也实现了更高的外分流成功率,在场景中达到52.3%对45.6%,随机达到27.6%对22.4%. 因此,其优势既包括分配业绩,也包括分配转变后的稳健性。 以1000小时自负为中心的模型在包括场景(48.2%对45.6%)和随机(25.9%对22.4%)在内的所有三种场合中也都超过了5000小时的机器人模型. 这些比较将验证-损失证据从人类范围扩大到了对RoboTwin的封闭-Loop任务的成功,在RoboTwin,自我中心前期训练可以产生更强大的下游政策,尽管其表现存在差距。

blocks.en: 3.8 From Egocentric Pretraining to Multi-View Robot Policies
blocks.zh: 3.8 来自爱歌中心 向多维机器人政策提供预训

blocks.en: Most egocentric human data are collected with a single head-mounted camera [ 20 , 43 ] . Although head-camera observations alone can support most robot manipulation tasks, wrist cameras provide complementary close-range views for precise gripper–object interactions and improve visibility when the head view is occluded [ 23 , 71 ] . We find that introducing wrist-camera inputs directly during robot post-training can substantially damage the generalization benefits of egocentric pretraining. EgoPro [ 75 ] provides approximately 1,000 hours of egocentric human video with synchronized head- and wrist-camera views. We use this dataset to investigate how to extend egocentric pretraining to multi-view robot policies while preserving its generalization benefits.
blocks.zh: 大多数以自负为中心的人类数据都是用单头式相机收集的[20,43]. 虽然单靠头-相机观测可以支持大多数机器人操纵任务,但手腕相机为精确的抓取器-对象交互提供了互补的近距离视图,并在头部视图被占用时提高能见度[23,71]. 我们发现,在机器人训练后直接引入手腕-相机输入会严重损害以自我为中心的先行训练的通俗化好处。 EgoPro [75] 提供约1000小时自负心的人类视频,同时提供同步头部和手腕相机的视角. 我们利用这个数据集来研究如何将以自我为中心的预训扩展到多景机器人政策,同时保留其通俗化的好处.

blocks.en: Figure 13 : From egocentric pretraining to multi-view robot policies. Three view configurations and training routes with or without EgoPro mid-training.
blocks.zh: 图13:从以自我为中心的先行训练到多景机器人政策. 三道有或无"EgoPro"中训的取景配置与训练路线.

blocks.en: We compare three configurations for visual conditioning and video prediction, illustrated in Figure 13 . Single-view uses the current head-camera observation and predicts future video from the single view. Multi-view conditioning adds current observations from both wrist cameras while restricting future video prediction to the head camera. Multi-view prediction uses the same three-camera inputs and predicts future video for all three views. We evaluate these variants separately under isolated attention with relative EEF actions and IDM attention with absolute camera-frame actions. Within each model configuration, all three variants are post-trained on RoboTwin from the same 20k-step egocentric pretraining checkpoint.
blocks.zh: 如图13所示,我们比较了视觉配置和视频预测的三种配置。 单取景使用当前头相机观测,并预测未来从单取景的视频. 多视图调制增加了从两个手腕相机中得出的当前观测结果,同时将未来的视频预测限制在头相机上. 多视图预测使用同一种三相机输入并预测未来所有三种视图的视频. 我们对这些变体分别进行单独评价,以相对的EEF动作,以绝对相机框动作进行IDM注意. 在每一个模型配置中,所有三个变体都是从相同的20k步自制前训练检查站在RoboTwin上进行后训练.

blocks.en: Table 5 : From egocentric pretraining to multi-view robot policies. RoboTwin success rates (%) from the best available complete post-training evaluation for each setting.
blocks.zh: 表5:从以自我为中心的预训到多景机器人政策. 机械Twin成功率(%)来自每场培训后最佳评价。

blocks.en: Table 5 shows that introducing wrist views during robot post-training under isolated attention degrades the out-of-distribution generalization gained from egocentric pretraining, while clean success decreases only slightly. Relative to Single-view , scene-ood success falls from 46.1% to 33.0–34.1% across the two multi-view variants, while random success falls from 22.5% to 12.9–14.8%. Under IDM attention, Multi-view conditioning improves clean success from 88.5% to 90.6% and maintains comparable random success, while scene-ood success decreases from 62.0% to 59.5%. With the input views unchanged, Multi-view prediction lowers success in all three settings relative to Multi-view conditioning , with scene-ood decreasing from 59.5% to 56.3% and random from 29.1% to 26.2%.
blocks.zh: 表5显示,在机器人接受孤立的注意后训练期间引入手腕视图,会降低从自我中心预训中获得的分流通俗化,而清洁成功则只略为减少. 相对于"单景",场景成功率从46.1%下降到33.0–34.1%,而两个多景变体的随机成功率从22.5%下降到12.9–14.8%. 在IDM关注下,多景调能将清洁成功率从88.5%提升到90.6%并保持可比较的随机成功率,而场景摄入成功率从62.0%降低到59.5%. 在输入视图不变的情况下,多视图预测会比多视图配置降低所有三种设置的成功率,场景收视率由59.5%下降到56.3%,随机率由29.1%下降到26.2%.

blocks.en: Under IDM attention, both multi-view configurations achieve lower scene-ood success than Single-view after direct robot post-training. We therefore investigate whether mid-training on EgoPro, which provides human egocentric videos with wrist-camera views, can bridge single-view egocentric pretraining and multi-view robot post-training while preserving the generalization gained from human data. For both Multi-view conditioning and Multi-view prediction , we compare this intermediate stage followed by robot post-training with direct post-training from the same pretrained checkpoint, keeping each view configuration fixed across mid-training and robot post-training.
blocks.zh: 在IDM关注下,两种多视图配置都比直接机器人后训练后的"Single-view"取得了更低的场景-ood成功. 因此,我们调查关于EgoPro的中期培训,该培训提供以手腕-相机观点为人类自我中心视频,是否能够在保留从人类数据获得的通俗化的同时,将单视自取自我中心前培训和多视机器人后培训相接。 对于多视点配置和多视点预测,我们比较了这一中间阶段,然后是机器人的后培训,然后是同一预先训练的检查站的直接后培训,使每个视图配置固定在中培训和机器人的后培训中。

blocks.en: Table 5 shows that mid-training improves out-of-distribution performance for both view configurations. With Multi-view conditioning , scene-ood success increases from 59.5% to 61.2% and random success from 29.1% to 30.7%. Multi-view prediction also improves, from 56.3% to 58.8% on scene-ood and from 26.2% to 27.4% on random. Clean success changes little with conditioning and decreases with prediction, so the gains are concentrated in out-of-distribution generalization. After mid-training, Multi-view conditioning approaches Single-view on scene-ood (61.2% versus 62.0%) and exceeds it on random (30.7% versus 28.6%). It also outperforms Multi-view prediction in all three settings, supporting our choice of Multi-view conditioning mid-training before robot post-training.
blocks.zh: 表5显示,中培训提高了两种视图配置的分流分流性能. 多景制式,场景成功率由59.5%增至61.2%,随机成功率由29.1%增至30.7%. 多视图预测也有所改善,从场景的56.3%到58.8%,从随机的26.2%到27.4%. 干净的成功随着调节的改变微乎其微,而随着预测的减少,因此收益集中在分配外的泛化上. 经过中训后,多景调节在场景上接近"单景"(61.2%对62.0%),随机超过(30.7%对28.6%). 它也超越了所有三种环境下的多视图预测,支持我们选择在机器人后训练前的多视图调节中训练.

blocks.en: 4 Pure Egocentric Data Foundation Model Training
blocks.zh: 4 纯爱中心 数据基金会 示范培训

blocks.en: Building on the exploration in Section 3, we develop HumanWAM-Vanilla, a world–action model pretrained exclusively on 50,000 hours of curated egocentric human data with aligned action trajectories. HumanWAM-Vanilla achieves competitive performance on the bimanual simulation benchmarks RoboTwin 2.0 and RoboDojo following robot post-training, with strengths in environmental robustness, precise control, and multi-step manipulation. Real-robot experiments further show that egocentric pretraining improves task success over a baseline without egocentric pretraining, with particularly large gains under visual distribution shifts.
blocks.zh: 基于第3节的探索,我们开发了HumanWAM-Vanilla,这是一个世界行动模型,它完全以5万小时的自负中心人类数据为基础,并配有一致的行动轨迹。 HumanWAM-Vanilla在双人模拟基准RoboTwin 2.0和RoboDojo在机器人后期训练中取得了竞争性能,在环境稳健性,精确控制,多步操控等方面都有优势. Real-robot实验进一步表明,以自我为中心的前期训练可以改善任务在基线上的成功,而不以自我为中心的前期训练,在视觉分布变化下特别大的收益.

blocks.en: 4.1 Model and Training Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 模式和培训设置

blocks.en: HumanWAM-Vanilla follows the world–action architecture described in Section 3.1.1 and uses inverse-dynamics attention, allowing action tokens to attend to both current and future video frames. During training, action denoising is conditioned on ground-truth future video latents with noise augmentation. For policy inference, the model first generates future video latents and then predicts an action chunk conditioned on these latents.
blocks.zh: HumanWAM-Vanilla遵循第3.1.1节所描述的世界行动架构,并使用反向动力学的注意,允许动作符号同时关注当前和未来视频帧. 在培训期间,除声行动取决于未来带有噪音增强的地面真实录像。 对于政策推论,模型首先生成未来的视频潜想,然后预测一个以这些潜想为条件的动作.

blocks.en: We use the unified 16-D bimanual end-effector action space defined in Section 2.3 . Each end effector is represented by its three-dimensional position, quaternion orientation, and gripper openness. EEF poses are expressed as absolute poses in the camera frame at the corresponding target time, with camera and wrist axes aligned across sources. Actions and proprioceptive states are standardized using dimension-wise z-score normalization after action alignment. Pretraining statistics are estimated jointly across the curated corpus, while mid-training and robot post-training use statistics estimated from their respective training datasets. Invalid or unsupervised hand dimensions are excluded from both normalization statistics and the action loss.
blocks.zh: 我们使用第2.3节所定义的统一的16-D双元最终效果动作空间. 每个终端效应器均由它的三维位置,四角取向,和抓取开口来代表. EEF外形在相应的目标时间被表示为相机框中的绝对外形,相机和手腕轴相互对接. 行动状态和自发状态在行动协调后,采用从维度到Z分的正常化标准。 培训前统计由各科室共同估算,而培训后中期和机器人则使用各自培训数据集估计的统计数据。 正常化统计和行动损失均不包括无效或不受监督的手部方面。

blocks.en: We pretrain the model exclusively on Open-HumanScale-50K curated and aligned as described in Section 2 , comprising human videos, language annotations, and action trajectories. The action chunk length is 32, and video frames are sampled every four action steps, yielding nine frames per sample. We optimize the model with AdamW [ 30 ] , setting the global batch size to 8,192 and the weight decay to 0.01 0.01 . The learning-rate schedule spans 100,000 optimizer steps, with linear warm-up to 10 − 4 10^{-4} over the first 5,000 steps followed by cosine decay to 10 − 6 10^{-6} .
blocks.zh: 正如第2节所描述的, 我们完全用开放的人类规模-50K来训练这个模型, 包括人类的视频、语言说明和行动轨迹。 动作块长度为32个,视频帧每四个动作步骤进行抽样,每个样本产生9个帧. 我们用 AdamW [30] 优化模型, 将全球批量大小设定为 8,192 并重衰减为 0.01 0.01 。 学习率表跨出10万个优化步骤,在前5000个步骤中,线性热能提升到10 - 4 10 - 4 - 4 10 - 4 }之后,余弦衰减到10 - 6 10 - 6 }。

blocks.en: After egocentric pretraining with a single head-camera view, mid-training adapts the model to multi-view inputs for robot policies. We continue training on EgoPro [ 75 ] , a human egocentric dataset with synchronized video from one head-mounted camera and two wrist-mounted cameras. Under Multi-view conditioning ( Section 3.8 ), current observations from all three cameras condition action prediction, while future video prediction remains restricted to the head camera.
blocks.zh: 在以单一头-相机视角为自我中心进行前期训练后,中后期训练会使模型适应机器人政策的多视图输入. 我们继续训练EgoPro [75], 一个以人类自我为中心的数据集, 在多视调(第3.8节)下,所有三相机条件动作预测的当前观测结果,而未来的视频预测仍然仅限于头相机.

blocks.en: Table 6 : Post-training settings for RoboTwin 2.0, RoboDojo, and real-robot experiments.
blocks.zh: 表6:为RoboTwin 2.0,RoboDojo以及真机器人实验提供的训练后设置.

blocks.en: Separate policies are post-trained for RoboTwin 2.0, RoboDojo, and real-robot experiments using the corresponding robot demonstrations. Table 6 summarizes the training data and optimization settings. RoboTwin–Clean2Clean and RoboTwin–Clean2Random use the same post-training data, comprising 50 clean demonstrations per task. Robot EEF poses follow the absolute camera-frame representation. Post-training uses AdamW with a weight decay of 0.01 0.01 and a cosine learning-rate schedule preceded by linear warm-up over the first 5% of optimization steps.
blocks.zh: 单独的政策是针对RoboTwin 2.0,RoboDojo的后期训练,以及使用相应机器人演示的真机器人实验. 表6概述了培训数据和优化设置。 RoboTwin–Clean2Clean和RoboTwin–Clean2Random使用相同的训练后数据,包括每任务50个清洁演示. 机器人EEF的姿态跟随绝对相机框的表示. 后训练使用AdamW,重量衰减为0.01 0.01,并采用余弦学习-速率表,先于最优化步骤的前5%进行线性取暖.

blocks.en: 4.2 Simulation Experiments
blocks.zh: 4.2 模拟实验

blocks.en: Since our egocentric pretraining primarily covers bimanual tabletop manipulation, we evaluate HumanWAM-Vanilla on RoboTwin 2.0 and RoboDojo. Comparisons with existing vision–language–action models and world–action models assess robustness to environmental variation and capabilities such as precision, memory, and long-horizon execution.
blocks.zh: 由于我们以自我为中心的预训主要包括双人平板电脑操纵,我们评价了HumanWAM-Vanilla在RoboTwin 2.0和RoboDojo上. 与现有愿景-语言-行动模型和世界-行动模型的比较评估了环境变化的稳健性以及精确性、记忆性和长距离执行等能力。

blocks.en: Table 7 : Evaluation results on RoboTwin 2.0. Success rates (%) are reported after clean-only post-training. Average is the mean of Clean2Clean and Clean2Random. The best result in each column is highlighted in bold.
blocks.zh: 表7: RoboTwin 2.0的评价结果. 成功率(%)是在经过清洁培训后报告的。 平均值为Clean2Clean和Clean2Random的平均值. 每栏的最佳结果以黑体突出。

blocks.en: RoboTwin 2.0 [ 9 ] is a benchmark built on SAPIEN [ 60 ] comprising 50 bimanual tabletop manipulation tasks on the Aloha-AgileX embodiment, including pick-and-place, stacking, object handovers, and articulated-object manipulation. We jointly post-train a single policy on clean demonstrations from all tasks and evaluate it in two settings. Clean2Clean evaluates performance within the demonstration environment distribution, whereas Clean2Random randomizes background and tabletop textures, lighting, clutter, and table height.
blocks.zh: RoboTwin 2.0 [9]是建立在SAPIEN [60]上的基准,由Aloha-AgileX浮雕上50个双人平板电脑操纵任务组成,包括取地取地,堆放取地,物体交接,以及清晰的物体操纵等. 我们共同培训一项从所有任务中进行清洁示范的单一政策,并在两个环境中加以评价。 Clean2Clean在演示环境分布范围内评价性能,而Clean2Random则随机地对背景和平面纹理,照明,杂乱无章地,和表高进行.

blocks.en: At inference, the policy receives RGB observations from the head camera and both wrist cameras, together with the language instruction and proprioceptive state. It predicts 32-step action chunks and executes the first 24 steps before replanning from updated observations. We evaluate the same checkpoint in both settings, with 100 episodes per task, totaling 5,000 episodes per setting. We report the mean success rate across the 50 tasks in each setting and the average of these two means.
blocks.zh: 推论,该政策从头相机和双腕相机接收到RGB的观测结果,以及语言指令和自发状态. 它预测了32个步骤的块并实施了前24个步骤,然后根据最新的观测结果重新规划。 我们评价两个场合的同一个检查点,每个任务100集,每个设置总共5000集. 我们报告每个场合50项任务的平均成功率和这两种方法的平均数。

blocks.en: Table 7 shows that HumanWAM-Vanilla achieves the highest Clean2Clean success rate among the compared methods, reaching 92.08% after post-training on 50 clean robot demonstrations per task. The same policy achieves 68.88% on Clean2Random, yielding an average success rate of 80.48% that exceeds all VLA baselines and most WAM baselines in the table. The remaining gap to the leading WAMs lies in out-of-distribution performance, with GO-3 Nano Preview reaching 81.48% on Clean2Random. This gap may partly reflect architectural differences, as HumanWAM-Vanilla uses a basic world–action architecture without additional specialized modules. These results support pretraining exclusively on human egocentric data as an effective foundation for bimanual robot manipulation, with accurate task execution and competitive generalization to visual conditions absent from the robot demonstrations.
blocks.zh: 表7显示,HumanWAM-Vanilla在比较方法中实现了最高的Clean2Clean成功率,在每次任务50次清洁机器人演示培训后达到92.08%. 同一政策在Clean2Random上实现了68.88%,平均成功率为80.48%,超过了表中所有VLA基线和大多数WAM基线。 领先的WAM的剩余差距在于分配外的性能,GO-3"纳诺预览"在Clean2Random上达到了81.48%. 这一差距可能部分反映了建筑差异,因为HumanWAM-Vanilla使用一个基本的世界-行动架构,而没有额外的专门模块。 这些结果支持了完全针对以人类自负为中心的数据进行预训,作为双人机器人操纵的有效基础,机器人演示中缺失精确的任务执行和对视觉条件的竞争性概括.

blocks.en: RoboDojo [ 8 ] is an Isaac Sim-based benchmark with 42 bimanual manipulation tasks covering generalization, precision, memory, long-horizon execution, and open-vocabulary instruction following. Many tasks require reasoning over action sequences and recalling earlier observations in addition to accurate motor control. We evaluate egocentric pretraining within the world–action architecture described in Section 4.1 , without adding dedicated reasoning or memory modules. Accordingly, we compare against representative VLA and WAM baselines and do not extend the evaluation to recent agentic or dual-system approaches.
blocks.zh: RoboDojo [8] 是一个基于Isaac Sim的基准,有42个双人操控任务,涵盖通论,精度,内存,长视野执行,以及随后的开放式活道指令. 许多任务都需要对动作序列进行推理,并除了精确的运动控制外,还要回顾先前的观测结果. 我们评价世界内部以自我为中心的先行训练 — — 第4.1节描述的行动架构,但没有增加专门的推理或记忆模块。 因此,我们比较具有代表性的VLA和WAM基线,不把评价扩大到最近的代理或双重系统办法。

blocks.en: We post-train on the official set of 3,500 robot demonstrations, comprising 100 demonstrations for each of 34 training tasks and 100 auxiliary domain-randomized demonstrations. The Open tasks are excluded from post-training. Generalization is evaluated separately under standard (Gen-Std) and randomized (Gen-Rand) conditions. We evaluate the same checkpoint across all six groups and report success rate, which measures complete task success, and progress score (0–100), which credits partial completion.
blocks.zh: 我们进行3500个机器人正式演示的训练后,包括34个训练任务中的每个任务100个演示和100个辅助域随机演示。 开放式任务被排除在培训后之外。 一般化在标准(Gen-Std)和随机化(Gen-Rand)条件下分别评价. 我们对所有六个小组的同一检查站进行评估,并报告成功率,衡量任务是否完全成功,并报告进展分数(0-100分),以部分完成。

blocks.en: Table 8 : RoboDojo comparison with VLA and WAM baselines. Each entry reports success rate (%) / progress score. Mean is recomputed for every method as an equally weighted average over the six groups.
blocks.zh: 表8:RoboDojo与VLA和WAM基线的比较。 每个条目报告成功率(%)/进度分数。 每一种方法的平均值均被重算为六组方法的等加权平均数。

blocks.en: Table 8 shows that HumanWAM-Vanilla achieves a mean success rate of 14.17% and a mean progress score of 19.00. It exceeds the WAM baselines in our comparison on both aggregate metrics and approaches the overall performance of Galaxea G0.5. Its advantage over OpenWAM- α \alpha is most pronounced on Precision and Long-Horizon, where success reaches 20.50% and 33.00%, compared with 9.25% and 25.33%, respectively. These results show that pretraining exclusively on human egocentric data, followed by adaptation with 100 robot demonstrations per training task, can support competitive robot manipulation, particularly in tasks requiring precise control and multi-step execution.
blocks.zh: 表8显示,HumanWAM-Vanilla的平均成功率为14.17%,平均进步分为19.00。 它超过了WAM的基线,我们比较了总指标,接近了Galaxea G0.5的整体性能. 其与OpenWAM-α-α的优势在精密度和长距线上最为突出,其成功率分别达到20.50%和33.00 %,而后者分别为9.25%和25.33%. 这些结果显示,只针对以人为中心的数据进行预先培训,然后每次培训任务进行100个机器人演示,可以支持竞争性机器人操纵,特别是在需要精确控制和多步骤执行的任务中.

blocks.en: HumanWAM-Vanilla achieves higher success rates than No-Ego on all four tasks in both settings ( Table 9 ). Mean in-distribution success increases from 57.5% to 87.5%. These gains span deformable-object manipulation and long-horizon execution, with success increasing from 50% to 80% on towel folding and from 50% to 90% on desk tidying. Mean out-of-distribution success increases from 2.5% to 67.5%, a gain of 65.0 pp compared with 30.0 pp in distribution. These results show that the generalization benefits of egocentric pretraining extend to physical robots, with improved task execution under visual conditions absent from the robot demonstrations.
blocks.zh: 在视觉分布转变下,差距会扩大。 HumanWAM-Vanilla在四项任务中取得了60-80%的成功,而No-Ego在40次分配外试验中只取得了一项成功。 平均分配外的成功率从2.5%增加到67.5%,比分配的30.0%增加了65.0页。 这些结果显示,以自我为中心的预训的通俗化好处扩展到了物理机器人,在视觉条件下更好的任务执行没有出现在机器人演示中.

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.4 阅读研究

blocks.en: To improve robot policy performance after post-training, we refine the model and training configuration used in the egocentric pretraining exploration. HumanWAM-Vanilla adopts IDM attention and absolute camera-frame actions in place of the default isolated attention and relative actions described in Section 3.1.1 . We examine these choices, together with action-expert initialization, through ablations on the four-source, 1,000-hour corpus described in Section 3.5 . All models are pretrained for 20,000 steps and post-trained for 12,000 steps on 50 clean demonstrations per RoboTwin task.
blocks.zh: 为了提高机器人在训练后的政策性能,我们完善了以自我为中心的预先训练探索中使用的模式和培训配置. HumanWAM-Vanilla采用IDM注意力和绝对相机框动作来取而代之的是第3.1.1节所描述的默认孤立注意力和相对动作. 我们审查这些选择,以及行动专家的初始化,方法是利用第3.5节所描述的4个来源的1 000小时程序。 所有型号在2万步前都经过了预训,在每架RoboTwin任务50个清洁演示上则经过了12000步后训练.

blocks.en: World–action models differ in how video and action tokens exchange information. We compare four attention strategies, each applied consistently throughout egocentric pretraining and robot post-training. Isolated attention restricts visual conditioning for action prediction to the current frame. Mutual attention allows video and action tokens to attend to each other during joint denoising. IDM attention conditions action denoising on ground-truth future video latents during training and generated future latents at inference. Optional-IDM , following the variant released by Fast-WAM [ 15 ] , trains a single model to predict actions with or without future video conditioning. Our implementation uses ground-truth future-video conditioning with probability 0.5 and current-frame-only conditioning otherwise.
blocks.zh: 世界行动模式在视频和行动符号如何交换信息方面有所不同。 我们比较了四种关注策略,每一种策略都一致地应用在以自我为中心的预训和机器人后训练中. 孤立的注意力限制了视觉条件,用于对当前帧的动作预测. 相互关注可以让视频和动作符号在联合发号施令时互相关注. IDM的注意条件为在培训期间采取行动消除地面真实未来视频的潜在作用,并产生未来的潜在作用。 object-IDM 在Fast-WAM[15]发布的变体后,训练出一个单一的模型,以预测有或没有未来视频调制的动作. 我们的实施工作采用地面真实未来录像条件,以概率为0.5,以其他方式只采用当前框架。

blocks.zh: 表10:关注战略与行动说明的分布情况。

blocks.en: Table 10 shows that mutual and IDM attention improve clean and scene-ood success over isolated attention with relative actions held fixed. Scene-ood success rises from 46.36% to 57.96% and 58.08%, respectively. IDM attention also improves random success from 22.40% to 27.56%. For Optional-IDM, enabling future video generation at inference raises clean success from 73.44% to 81.96% and scene-ood success from 48.44% to 57.04% using the same checkpoint. These results indicate that generating future video before predicting actions improves both in-domain fitting and generalization under distribution shift.
blocks.zh: 表10显示,相互和IDM的注意比孤立的注意和固定的相对行动改善了清洁和现场效果。 场景成功率由46.36%分别上升到57.96%和58.08%. IDM关注率也提高了随机成功率,从22.40%提高到27.56%. 就可选的IDM而言,通过推论使未来的视频生成将使用同一检查站的场景成功率从73.44%提高到81.96%,场景成功率从48.44%提高到57.04%。 这些结果表明,在预测行动之前制作未来的视频,既能改善域内配装,又能改善分配转变中的通俗化。

blocks.en: Embodied pretraining methods adopt different action representations. Relative EEF motions are commonly used to reduce dependence on global coordinate frames and facilitate cross-embodiment transfer [ 10 , 73 ] . We compare relative and absolute camera-frame actions, retaining each representation throughout egocentric pretraining and robot post-training. Relative actions express target EEF poses with respect to the EEF pose at the current observation, whereas absolute actions express them directly in the camera frame at each target time.
blocks.zh: 健全的预训方法采用不同的动作表述. 相对的EEF运动通常用于减少对全球坐标架的依赖,并便利交叉化转移[10,73]. 我们比较相对和绝对的相机框架行动,保留每一个以自我为中心的预训和机器人后训练的表述. 相对动作表达EEF对当前观测时EEF所呈现的目标,而绝对动作则在每个目标时间直接在相机框中表达.

blocks.en: Table 10 shows that absolute camera-frame actions improve clean and scene-ood performance over relative actions under both mutual and IDM attention. Under IDM attention, clean success increases from 83.56% to 88.48% and scene-ood success from 58.08% to 62.00%, with a smaller improvement on random. With mutual attention, clean success increases from 81.28% to 84.88% and scene-ood success from 57.96% to 61.12%.
blocks.zh: 表10显示,绝对相机框架行动比在相互和IDM关注下的相对行动提高了清洁和场景摄取性能。 在IDM关注下,清洁成功率从83.56%上升到88.48%,场景成功率从58.08%上升到62.00%,随机改进幅度较小. 在相互关注下,清洁成功率从81.28%上升到84.88%,场景成功率从57.96%上升到61.12%.

blocks.en: We further examine whether to initialize the action expert randomly or from linearly interpolated pretrained Wan2.2 weights before egocentric pretraining. Both variants start from the same pretrained video backbone and are pretrained for 20,000 steps on the same four-source, 1,000-hour corpus. They use IDM attention and absolute camera-frame actions throughout pretraining and post-training, with identical photometric augmentation during the 12,000-step robot post-training stage. We observed that initializing the action expert from video-model weights does not improve downstream success in this comparison ( Table 11 ). The two variants achieve comparable clean and scene-ood success, while random initialization increases random success from 51.52% to 54.12%.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步审查是随机或从线性插入的Wan2.2分量中先初始化行动专家,然后再进行以自我为中心的先行训练。 两种变体都从同一预训视频主干线起步,并在同一种四源,1000小时的活体上被预训出两万步. 它们在整个培训前和培训后使用IDM注意力和绝对相机框动作,在12,000步机器人培训后阶段使用相同的光度增强. 我们观察到,从视频模型权重中将行动专家初始化并不能改善下游的成功(表11)。 两个变体都取得了可比较的清洁和场景-摄取成功,而随机初始化将随机成功率从51.52%提高到54.12%.

blocks.en: 5 Pushing the Model Capability Boundary with Hybrid Data Scaling
blocks.zh: 5 以混合数据缩放推进示范能力边界

blocks.en: Scaling pure egocentric pretraining to 50k hours instills strong manipulation priors, substantially improving out-of-distribution generalization after task-specific post-training. However, purely human pretraining leaves an inherent embodiment gap: without exposure to physical robot morphology and control dynamics, the model cannot be deployed directly and remains confined to a finetuning paradigm that requires demonstrations for every target task. Conversely, while large-scale robot datasets [ 58 ] provide direct, executable control supervision, scaling teleoperated trajectories alone quickly plateaus due to collection cost and limited scene diversity. To overcome these single-modality bottlenecks, we investigate joint co-training on human and robot data within an extended unified action space. Through systematic scaling experiments across progressive human and robot data budgets, we characterize how hybrid data scaling expands the boundary of model generalization and execution capability.
blocks.zh: 将纯粹的自负式预训扩大到50小时,从而注入了强大的操纵前科,大大改进了任务特定后培训后分配的概况。 然而,纯粹的人类先行训练留下了内在的表征差距:没有接触物理机器人形态和控制动力学,模型无法被直接部署,仍然局限于需要为每一项目标任务进行演示的微调范式. 反之,虽然大型机器人数据集[58]提供直接可执行的控制监督,但由于收集成本和场景多样性有限,仅缩放远程操作的轨迹就快速高地. 为了克服这些单一模式的瓶颈,我们调查了在扩大的统一行动空间内关于人和机器人数据的联合培训。 通过在进步的人类和机器人数据预算中的系统规模化实验,我们描述混合数据规模如何扩大模型通缩和执行能力的界限.

blocks.en: A central question is whether scaling hybrid training experience reduces reliance on task-specific adaptation. We therefore evaluate our co-trained models across two complementary protocols. In the zero-shot protocol , the pretrained checkpoint is deployed directly in simulation and on physical robots without target-task demonstrations or parameter updates, testing whether larger hybrid budgets expand the repertoire of tasks executable out of the box. In the post-training protocol , the same checkpoints are finetuned on target-task demonstrations, assessing whether hybrid pretraining continues to raise the performance ceiling once in-domain data are available, particularly under out-of-distribution shifts.
blocks.zh: 一个核心问题是,推广混合培训经验是否减少了对具体任务适应的依赖。 因此,我们评价我们通过两个补充议定书共同培训的模式。 在"零射"协议中,被预先训练的检查站被直接部署在模拟中和在没有目标任务演示或参数更新的物理机器人上,测试更大的混合预算是否将可执行的任务的重排扩展出框. 在培训后协议中,同样的检查站在目标任务示范方面得到微调,评估一旦获得域内数据,混合预训是否继续提高性能上限,特别是在分配外转移的情况下。

blocks.en: Deploying a generalist policy without task-specific finetuning also requires an unambiguous interface to specify unfamiliar tasks. Because natural language instructions often leave object configurations, spatial relations, and terminal states underspecified, we augment our world-action model with explicit goal-image conditioning [ 18 ] . The resulting model, HumanWAM-Goal , jointly predicts future visual states and executable actions from current observations and a visual goal. Beyond disambiguating task intent for zero-shot execution, this interface enables embodied in-context learning [ 28 ] , steering a frozen policy toward distinct manipulation outcomes purely by varying the visual goal at inference time.
blocks.zh: 在不针对具体任务进行微调的情况下实施笼统政策,还需要一个明确的接口,以具体说明不熟悉的任务。 由于自然语言指令往往会留下对象配置,空间关系,以及终端状态等不精确的地方,所以我们用明确的目标-图像条件来增强我们的世界行动模式[18]. 由此而来的模式"HumanWAM-Goal"(HumanWAM-Goal)共同预测了未来视觉状态和从当前观察和一个视觉目标中可执行的行动. 除了零发执行的任务意向模糊之外,这一接口还能够使文字中体现的学习[28],将冻结的政策转向明显的操纵结果,纯粹通过在推断时改变视觉目标。

blocks.en: To realize this framework, we first introduce our robot pretraining corpus ( Section 5.1 ), extend the unified action representation ( Section 5.2 ), and detail the HumanWAM-Goal architecture ( Section 5.3 ) alongside its co-training recipe ( Section 5.4 ). We then formalize our evaluation protocols ( Section 5.5 ), examine zero-shot and post-trained scaling trends ( Section 5.6 ), and finally demonstrate emergent zero-shot execution, visual in-context learning, and long-horizon manipulation on physical robots in Section 6 .
blocks.zh: 为了实现这一框架,我们首先介绍我们的机器人预训(第5.1节),扩大统一行动代表(第5.2节),并详细说明人类WAM-目标架构(第5.3节)及其共同培训方法(第5.4节)。 然后,我们正式确定我们的评估协议(第5.5节),审查零发和后训练的缩放趋势(第5.6节),最后在第6节中展示出即兴的零发执行、视觉内涵学习和对物理机器人的长期操纵。

blocks.en: 5.2 Hybrid Action Representation
blocks.zh: 5.2 混合行动代表

blocks.en: To accommodate multi-embodiment robot control and mobile manipulation alongside human videos, we extend the 16-D bimanual action space of Section 2.3 into a 49-D hybrid representation: 𝐚 t ext = [ 𝐣 t ⏟ joint: 23 , 𝐛 t ⏟ chassis: 3 , 𝐚 t , 𝐩 t H , 𝐪 t H ⏟ EEF and head: 23 ] ∈ ℝ 49 . \mathbf{a}^{\mathrm{ext}}_{t}=\big[\underbrace{\mathbf{j}_{t}}_{\text{joint: }23},\;\underbrace{\mathbf{b}_{t}}_{\text{chassis: }3},\;\underbrace{\mathbf{a}_{t},\,\mathbf{p}^{H}_{t},\,\mathbf{q}^{H}_{t}}_{\text{EEF and head: }23}\big]\in\mathbb{R}^{49}.
