blocks.en: To serve as a general-purpose action executor for multimodal agents [ 48 , 28 ] , a foundation policy must translate explicit target outcomes into continuous physical control without task-specific parameter updates. We therefore introduce HumanWAM-Goal ( Figure 16 ), which augments world-action modeling with explicit visual-goal conditioning [ 18 ] . Given a language instruction ℓ \ell , current observation 𝐨 t \mathbf{o}_{t} , proprioceptive state 𝐬 t \mathbf{s}_{t} , optional observation history ℋ t \mathcal{H}_{t} , and a goal image 𝐠 \mathbf{g} specifying a desired intermediate or terminal scene configuration, the model estimates p θ ​ ( 𝐎 t + , 𝐀 t ∣ 𝐜 t ) , 𝐜 t = ( ℓ , 𝐨 t , 𝐬 t , ℋ t , 𝐠 ) , p_{\theta}\!\left(\mathbf{O}^{+}_{t},\mathbf{A}_{t}\mid\mathbf{c}_{t}\right),\qquad\mathbf{c}_{t}=\left(\ell,\mathbf{o}_{t},\mathbf{s}_{t},\mathcal{H}_{t},\mathbf{g}\right), (6) where 𝐎 t + \mathbf{O}^{+}_{t} denotes 12 12 future video frames and 𝐀 t ∈ ℝ 48 × 49 \mathbf{A}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{48\times 49} is a 48 48 -step action chunk in the hybrid action space of Section 5.2 . We build HumanWAM-Goal upon the pretrained Cosmos3-Nano-16B backbone [ 37 ] , which pairs a frozen Qwen3-VL-based Reasoner for language encoding with a shared video-action Generator .

blocks.en: To enable unambiguous task specification without modifying the backbone topology, all visual inputs are encoded into spatial latents via a frozen Wan VAE and mapped into the Generator through a shared visual projection P v i P^{i}_{v} . While the current observation 𝐨 t \mathbf{o}_{t} serves as the clean anchor frame of the rollout, the goal image 𝐠 \mathbf{g} is encoded separately, augmented with a learnable goal embedding, and supplied as clean conditioning tokens. This design preserves the fine-grained spatial structure of the desired outcome while distinguishing goal targets from current observations. When historical frames ℋ t \mathcal{H}_{t} are included, they enter as additional clean visual tokens with temporal rotary position embeddings (RoPE) reflecting their elapsed time relative to 𝐨 t \mathbf{o}_{t} .
blocks.zh: 为了在不修改主干地貌的情况下实现清晰的任务规格,所有视觉输入都通过被冻结的Wan VAE被编码成空间潜伏,并通过共享视觉投影P v i P^{i}_{v}被映射入生成器. 虽然当前的观测 o t \ mathbf{o}_{t} 充当了推出的清洁锚地框架, 目标图像 g\ mathbf{g} 却被单独编码, 并用可学习的目标嵌入来扩充, 并作为清洁的调制符号提供 。 这种设计保留了所期望结果的精细空间结构,同时将目标目标与目前的观测区分开来. 当包含历史帧 H t\ mathcal{H}_{t} 时, 它们作为额外的干净的视觉符号输入, 带有时间回转位置嵌入( RoPE) , 反映它们相对于 o t\ mathb{o}_{t} 所经过的时间 。

blocks.en: In language-only world-action modeling ( Section 4.4 ), where terminal states are visually underspecified, two-stage inverse-dynamics (IDM) inference—generating complete future video latents prior to action denoising—is essential to ground control in predicted visual dynamics, albeit at double the sequential sampling cost. In HumanWAM-Goal, because the clean goal tokens 𝐠 \mathbf{g} directly anchor the target spatial configuration, we replace two-stage cascading with single-stage joint rectified-flow sampling within the shared-parameter Generator ( Figure 16 ). Specifically, video and action tokens share Transformer weights and interact bidirectionally at every denoising step through joint self-attention via modality-specific projections P v i / o P^{i/o}_{v} and P a i / o P^{i/o}_{a} . We interface the 49-D hybrid representation ( Section 5.2 ) by prepending the normalized current state 𝐬 t \mathbf{s}_{t} as a single clean conditioning row ahead of the 48 48 noisy future action rows, restricting the rectified-flow loss strictly to future actions. At inference, holding all conditioning tokens 𝐜 t \mathbf{c}_{t} fixed, the Generator synchronously denoises future video latents and the 48-step action chunk via iterative UniPC updates, preserving world-to-action coupling while halving sampling latency and optionally bypassing the Wan VAE decoder for real-time control.
blocks.zh: 在仅使用语言的世界行动模型(第4.4节)中,终端状态视差不足,两阶段反向动力学(IDM)推论——在行动去诺之前产生完整的未来视频潜伏——对于预测的视觉动力学的地面控制至关重要,尽管是相继取样成本的两倍。 在HumanWAM-Goal中,因为干净的入球标志g\mathbf{g}直接锁定目标空间配置,所以我们在共享参数生成器内用单级联合正流采样来取代双相分层(图16)。 影片与动作符号分享变形器的权重, 我们连接了49-D混合代表(第5.2节),在48个吵闹的未来行动行之前,先将正常状态的 t / mathb{s}_{t}作为单一的整齐条件行,将纠正后的流动损失严格限制在将来的行动中。 推论,持有所有调节符 ct\mathbf{c}_{t} 固定, 生成器同步地将未来的视频潜伏和48步动作块通过迭接的UniPC更新, 保留了从世界到行动耦合, 同时将采样延迟减半, 并可选地绕出 Wan VAE 解码器进行实时控制.

blocks.en: 5.4 Training Recipe
blocks.zh: 5.4 培训工具

blocks.en: We investigate human–robot data scaling through two complementary series. In the robot-only series , we progressively expand the robot training corpus from 2,005 to 14,618 hours (2,005 / 4,261 / 8,475 / 14,618 hours), drawn from eight real-world robot domains ( Section 5.1 ). In the hybrid series , we hold the robot corpus fixed at 14,618 hours and incorporate either 15,901 or 45,938 hours of egocentric human data drawn from the curated corpus in Section 2.1 , yielding total training budgets of approximately 30.5k and 60.6k hours, respectively. This design isolates the benefits of scaling robot demonstrations from the additional contribution of human experience at a fixed robot-data budget. Both modalities are represented in the unified action space described in Section 5.2 .
blocks.zh: 我们通过两个互补的系列来调查人类机器人数据。 在只使用机器人的系列中,我们逐渐将机器人训练仪从2,005小时增加到14,618小时(2,005 / 4.261 / 8.475 / 14.618小时),取自于8个现实世界机器人领域(第5.1节. 在混合体系列中,我们把机器人体固定在14 618小时,并纳入15 901小时或45 938小时的自负式人类数据,这些数据来自第2.1节的自负式人体体,培训总预算分别为30.5k小时和60.6k小时。 这种设计将扩大机器人演示的好处与人类经验在固定机器人数据预算中的额外贡献相隔离. 第5.2.节所述的统一行动空间体现了这两种模式。

blocks.en: During co-training, goal images are sampled online from future observations within the same trajectory using an identical strategy for human and robot data. For each training example, we sample a clean head-camera frame from four goal-conditioning options: a future observation 2–8 s ahead (40%), the episode’s terminal observation (20%), the final observation of an upcoming annotated subtask (20%), or an empty goal (20%). Goal timestamps are constrained to lie at or beyond the end of the supervised action chunk. Each goal image is encoded with a learnable goal embedding and serves exclusively as a conditioning signal without an associated reconstruction loss. When the goal is omitted, its tokens are removed entirely, enabling a single model to support both goal-conditioned and language-only execution.
blocks.zh: 在共同训练期间,目标图像利用相同的人类和机器人数据战略,从同一轨迹内的未来观测中进行在线取样。 每一次培训,我们都会从四个目标调节选项中抽取一个干净的头相机框架:未来的观察2比8领先(40 % ) , 剧集的终端观察(20 % ) , 对即将到来的附加说明的子任务的最后观察(20 % ) , 或者空入目标(20 % ) 。 目标时间戳被限制在受监督的行动块末端或之后。 每个目标图像被编码为可学习的目标嵌入,并完全作为没有相关重建损失的调节信号. 在省略目标时,其符号被完全去除,使得一个单一的模型能够同时支持有目标条件和只使用语言的执行.

blocks.en: All configurations start from the same pretrained Cosmos3-Nano-16B initialization. We optimize the Generator, timestep embeddings, visual and action projections, action modality embedding, and goal embedding, while keeping the Reasoner and VAE frozen. Training uses FusedAdam with a base learning rate of 4 × 10 − 5 4\times 10^{-5} , ( β 1 , β 2 ) = ( 0.9 , 0.99 ) (\beta_{1},\beta_{2})=(0.9,0.99) , weight decay of 0.05 0.05 , gradient-norm clipping at 1.0 1.0 , and a global batch size of 1,024. The learning rate increases linearly over the first 1,000 steps and subsequently decays linearly over a 500k-step schedule. We apply a 5 × 5\times learning-rate multiplier to the action projections, action modality embedding, and goal embedding. All evaluations use exponential moving average (EMA) weights.
blocks.zh: 所有配置都从相同的预训宇宙3-Nano-16B初始化开始. 我们优化了发电机,时间步嵌入,视觉和行动预测,动作模式嵌入,以及目标嵌入,同时使"理性"和"VAE"保持了冻结. 培训采用FusedAdam,基础学习率为4×10−5 4\times 10^5},(β 1,β 2) = (0.9, 0.99) (\beta_{1},\beta_{2}) = (0.9,0.99) 体重衰减为0.05,梯度-标准剪接为1.01.0,全球批量大小为1,024. 学习速度在最初的1000个步骤中呈线性增长,随后在500个步骤的时间表中呈线性衰减. 我们在行动预测、行动模式嵌入和目标嵌入中采用5×5\时的学习率乘数。 所有评价都使用指数移动平均权重。

blocks.en: For simulation evaluation, we initialize from the co-trained checkpoint and adapt the model using 50 clean demonstrations from the ALOHA-AgileX robot per RoboTwin task, totaling 2,500 trajectories. Table 12 summarizes the adaptation protocols used in our post-training scaling and leaderboard evaluations ( Section 5.6.2 ). Action normalization statistics are computed jointly from the clean RoboTwin datasets and pretraining data.
blocks.zh: 为了模拟评价,我们从共同训练的检查站起步并使用每架RoboTwin任务的ALOHA-AgileX机器人的50个清洁演示来调整模型,总共2500个出轨. 表12概述了我们在培训后规模和领导板评价中使用的适应议定书(第5.6.2节)。 行动正常化统计数据由干净的RoboTwin数据集和预训数据共同计算。

blocks.en: For goal specification during post-training, we use a mixture of ground-truth terminal frames and synthesized goal images. Specifically, 20% of the training episodes use the ground-truth terminal observation as the goal, while the remaining 80% use goal images synthesized by GPT Image 2.5 [ 39 ] . Each goal image is generated from the initial scene observation and task instruction using a fixed task-specific prompt (Appendix 9 ). To ensure fidelity to the intended task, every generated image undergoes an automated review using ChatGPT Astra High [ 40 ] , which verifies the target object and destination, designated manipulation arm, object count and appearance, and background and viewpoint consistency. Images that fail any check are regenerated and reviewed until accepted; this procedure enforces visual and instructional consistency rather than physical feasibility. At evaluation time, each scene is assigned a single generated goal image shared across all evaluated checkpoints to eliminate goal variation as a source of performance differences.
blocks.zh: 对于训练后期的入球规格,我们使用地面-真实的终端框架和综合入球图像的混合. 具体来说,20%的训练节目以地面-真实终端观测为目标,而其余的80%则使用由GPT Image 2.5 [39]所合成的目标图像. 每个目标图像都是从初始场景观测和任务指令中利用固定的任务特有提示来生成的(附录9 . 为确保忠实于预定任务,每个生成的图像都使用ChatGPT Astra High [40]进行自动审查,以验证目标对象和目的地、指定的操纵臂、物体计数和外观以及背景和观点的一致性。 任何检查失败的图像都会被重新生成和审查,直到被接受;这个程序执行视觉和指令一致性而不是物理可行性. 在评价时,每个场景都被分配到一个单一生成的、在所有受评价的检查站共享的目标图像,以消除作为业绩差异来源的变异目标。

blocks.en: 5.5 Evaluation Settings
blocks.zh: 5.5 评价设置

blocks.en: To ensure reproducibility and fair comparison with existing robot policies, we adopt RoboTwin 2.0 [ 9 ] , a standardized simulation benchmark for bimanual manipulation. Built on the SAPIEN physics engine, RoboTwin 2.0 provides 50 manipulation tasks with predefined success criteria and controlled environmental variations. We evaluate all models using the ALOHA-AgileX embodiment, which is never exposed during pretraining. During each episode, the policy receives visual observations, robot states, and task instructions, executing actions in closed loop. Task success is determined by the benchmark’s automated, task-specific completion checks.
blocks.zh: 为了保证与现有的机器人政策可复制性和公平比较,我们采用了RoboTwin 2.0 [9],这是双人操纵的标准化模拟基准. 由SAPIEN物理引擎所建,RoboTwin 2.0提供50个操纵任务,并预设成功标准并控制了环境变异. 我们使用ALOHA-AgileX 来评价所有模型,在预训期间从未暴露过. 在每集期间,政策会接收视觉观测,机器人状态,以及任务指示,以闭环方式执行动作. 任务的成功取决于基准的自动化和具体任务完成情况检查。

blocks.en: RoboTwin 2.0 defines two evaluation conditions: Clean , which uses the default scene configuration, and Random , which introduces variations in backgrounds, lighting, object clutter, and table height. Together, they assess task execution under standard conditions and robustness to environmental shifts across the same 50 tasks and identical success criteria.
blocks.zh: RoboTwin 2.0定义了两个评价条件:Clean 使用默认的场景配置;Random 引入了背景,照明,对象杂乱,和表高等变化. 它们共同评估在标准条件下执行任务的情况,评估在50项相同任务中向环境转变的力度和相同的成功标准。

blocks.en: We consider two complementary protocols to disentangle the capabilities acquired during co-training from those gained through target-task adaptation ( Table 12 ). In the zero-shot protocol, co-trained checkpoints are deployed directly on RoboTwin 2.0 without any target-task demonstrations or parameter updates, testing whether scaling hybrid experience enables unseen manipulation tasks to be executed out of the box. In the post-training protocol, each co-trained checkpoint is adapted using 50 Clean demonstrations per task to evaluate how pretraining scale affects downstream in-domain fit and out-of-distribution generalization. For computational efficiency, zero-shot evaluations use 50 episodes per task under each condition (Clean and Random), whereas post-training scaling and leaderboard evaluations follow the official protocol of 100 episodes per task and condition (10,000 episodes in total).

blocks.en: 6 Emerging Capabilities in Real-World Robot Behavior
blocks.zh: 6 现实世界机器人行为的新能力

blocks.en: While recent multimodal agents exhibit strong high-level reasoning and task planning [ 48 , 28 ] , translating semantic intent into physical work requires a general-purpose action executor that can reliably control real robots. Building on the simulation scaling trends in Section 5 —which show that joint human–robot co-training with visual-goal conditioning instills transferable visuomotor priors—we transition to physical hardware to evaluate whether HumanWAM-Goal can bridge this gap. Central to our deployment is explicit goal-image conditioning, which decouples high-level task specification from low-level sensorimotor control. Rather than relying solely on language instructions that often leave spatial arrangements and terminal states underspecified, an upstream planner or user supplies a visual goal as inference-time context. This unified interface allows the model to serve both as an “out-of-the-box” executor for unseen tasks and as a scalable foundation for downstream post-training.
blocks.zh: 虽然最近的多模式代理表现出了强大的高层次推理和任务规划[48,28],但将语义意图转化为物理工作需要一个能够可靠地控制真正的机器人的通用动作执行器. 以第5节的模拟缩放趋势为基础——该趋势表明,与可视目标条件相结合的人类-机器人联合训练将推进可转移的粘接器前传——我们向物理硬件过渡,以评估人类WAM-目标是否能够弥补这一差距。 我们部署的核心是明确的入门成像调节,它将高级任务规格与低级感应器控制脱钩。 上游规划者或用户不只依靠往往未对空间安排和终端状态作出明确规定的语言指示,而是以推断时间为背景提供视觉目标。 这种统一的接口使该模型既能作为“箱外”执行者,又能作为下游培训后可扩展的基础。

blocks.en: Following our experimental setup ( Section 6.1 ), we evaluate the real-world behaviors of HumanWAM-Goal across three core capabilities. First, we investigate zero-shot real-world manipulation ( Section 6.2 ) by deploying co-trained checkpoints directly across a 20-task benchmark, quantifying how hybrid human–robot scaling expands the set of skills executable without target-task demonstrations or parameter updates. Second, we examine embodied in-context learning ( Section 6.3 ), testing whether a policy with strictly frozen weights—both before and after post-training—can dynamically alter its manipulation trajectory in response to varying robot- or human-depicted visual goals. Finally, we demonstrate long-horizon execution ( Section 6.4 ) on post-trained policies, showcasing temporal continuity and subgoal chaining across extended, multi-stage tabletop and mobile-manipulation workflows.
blocks.zh: 在我们的实验设置(第6.1节)之后,我们评价了人类WAM-目标跨越三个核心能力的现实世界行为. 首先,我们通过在20个任务基准上直接部署共同训练的检查站来调查零镜头现实世界操纵(第6.2节),量化混合人-机器人缩放如何在没有目标任务演示或参数更新的情况下扩展成套可执行技能。 第二,我们审查内在文字学习(第6.3节),测试严格冻结重量的政策——在培训前后——是否能够动态地改变其操纵轨迹,以适应各种机器人或人类想象的视觉目标。 最后,我们展示了经培训后政策的长期执行(第6.4节),显示了时间连续性和次级目标连锁,跨越扩展的多阶段桌面和移动操纵工作流程。

blocks.en: 6.1 Real-Robot Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 6.1 真机器人实验设置

blocks.en: We conduct physical-robot evaluations on Astribot S1 , a wheeled mobile manipulator with an articulated torso. Across all experiments, policies receive RGB observations from a head-mounted camera and two wrist cameras alongside proprioceptive robot states, predicting a 48-step ( 1.6 ​ s 1.6\,\text{s} ) action chunk in the unified 49-D hybrid action space ( Section 5.2 ). Desired task outcomes are specified at inference time via the goal-image interface ( Section 5.3 ), using target scene configurations captured from held-out robot demonstrations or egocentric human demonstrations ( Section 6.3 ). To ensure low-latency closed-loop control on physical hardware, we deploy our models using PhyAI [ 41 ] , which leverages tensor parallelism and highly optimized kernels to achieve a 2.2 × 2.2\times inference speedup over a PyTorch baseline with CUDA Graphs.
blocks.zh: 我们对Astribot S1进行物理机器人评估,这是一个轮式移动操纵器,具有清晰的躯干。 在所有实验中,政策从一个头架相机和两个手腕相机与自控机器人状态一起接收RGB的观测结果,预测一个48步(1.6 s 1.6\,\text{s})的动作块在统一的49-D混合动作空间(第5.2节). 通过目标-图像接口(第5.3节),利用从被搁置的机器人演示或以自我为中心的人类演示中捕获的目标场景配置(第6.3节),在推断时具体说明理想的任务结果。 为了保证对物理硬件的低纬度闭路控制,我们使用PhyAI [41] 部署我们的模型,它利用了拉伸平行论和高度优化的内核,在使用 CUDA Graphs 的 PyTorch 基线上实现2.2× 2.2分的推论速度.

blocks.en: Our zero-shot benchmark comprises 20 manipulation tasks stratified into 10 easy and 10 hard tasks. The suite spans five core manipulation families: contact and state changes (4 tasks), grasping and transport (5), articulated opening and closing (3), spatial placement and alignment (6), and stacking and insertion (2). We conduct 10 trials per task, totaling 200 rollouts per evaluated checkpoint.

Specifically, each task k k is decomposed into M k M_{k} ordered, non-overlapping stages with fixed completion criteria judged manually from visual observations and end-effector poses. blocks.en: For intricate, multi-stage, or long-horizon tasks that exceed zero-shot reliability, we adapt the co-trained checkpoint via task-specific post-training, resetting the optimizer, learning-rate schedule, and data sampler. We retain the co-training normalization statistics and recalculate only channels with substantially shifted distributions (e.g., the articulated torso of Astribot S1). During post-training, goal images are sampled online from the final frame of one of the next two annotated subtasks, a future frame within 4 ​ s 4\,\text{s} , or an empty goal. To improve robustness and enforce reliance on visual goals and shared EEF representations, we apply 20 % 20\% dropout to the joint-state input branch, 10 % 10\% dropout to language instructions, and weight the action loss 10 × 10\times relative to the video prediction loss. We select the EMA checkpoint that minimizes end-effector average displacement error (ADE) on held-out validation episodes.
blocks.zh: 对于复杂,多阶段,或长距离,超过零射可靠性的任务,我们通过任务特定的后训练来调整共同训练的检查站,重新设置优化器,学习率时间表,以及数据取样器. 我们保留了共同训练正常化统计,并只用大幅改变分布的渠道(如Astribot S1的清晰躯干)重新计算。 在后训练期间,入球图像从下两个附加说明子任务之一的最终框架,即4 s 4\,\text{s}内的未来框架,或空入入入球中进行在线采样. 为了增强活力、强化对视觉目标的依赖以及共享的EEF表达方式,我们将20%的20-%的辍学应用到联合州输入处,10%的10-%的辍学应用到语言指令中,并且将动作损失与视频预测损失相比的10-10\时间进行加权。 我们选择EMA检查点, 以在被搁置的验证事件上最小化端效应器平均移位错误( ADE) 。

blocks.en: 6.2 Real-World Zero-Shot Performance
blocks.zh: 6.2 真实世界零热能

blocks.en: We evaluate the zero-shot transfer of HumanWAM-Goal on physical hardware by comparing the robot-only baseline ( 14,618 ​ h 14,618\,\text{h} ) against hybrid checkpoints co-trained with an additional 15,901 15,901 or 45,938 45,938 hours of egocentric human data (yielding total budgets of 30,519 ​ h 30,519\,\text{h} and 60,556 ​ h 60,556\,\text{h} , respectively). All checkpoints are deployed directly out of the box without target-task demonstrations or parameter updates.
blocks.zh: 我们评价人类WAM-目标在物理硬件上的零射入,将机器人基线(14,618 h 14,618\,\text{h})与联合训练的混合检查站相比较,再增加15,901个15,901个或45,938个45,938小时的自我中心人类数据(使总预算分别为30,519 h 30,519\,\text{h}和60,556 h 60,556\,\text{h})。 所有检查站都直接从箱外部署,没有目标任务演示或参数更新。

Success rates across easy and hard tasks as egocentric human data are added to a fixed 14,618 ​ h 14,618\,\text{h} robot corpus. The vertical dashed line at 60,556 ​ h 60,556\,\text{h} highlights the additional gain on hard tasks from robot-balanced batch sampling ( + 8 ​ pp +8\,\text{pp} ).

blocks.en: Figure 20 illustrates how scaling hybrid data affects real-world zero-shot execution across different task difficulties. As egocentric human data expand from 0 0 to 15.9 ​ k 15.9\text{k} and 45.9 ​ k 45.9\text{k} hours, success on easy tasks rises steadily from 32.0 % 32.0\% to 34.0 % 34.0\% and 42.0 % 42.0\% ( + 10.0 ​ pp +10.0\,\text{pp} overall), while success on hard tasks more than doubles from 8.0 % 8.0\% to 18.0 % 18.0\% and 19.0 % 19.0\% ( + 11.0 ​ pp +11.0\,\text{pp} ). These consistent gains confirm that visuomotor priors learned from human manipulation transfer directly to physical robot execution.
blocks.zh: 图20说明了混合数据规模如何影响不同任务困难中的现实世界零发执行. 随着以自我为中心的人类数据从0到15.9k 15.9\text{k}和45.9k 45.9\text{k}小时的扩展,轻松任务的成功率由32.0% 32.0\%到34.0% 34.0\%到42.0% 42.0\%(+10 pp +1.0\,\text{pp}总体),而艰巨任务的成功率则由8.0% 8.0\%到18.0% 18.0\%到19.0% 19.0\% (+11.0 pp +11.0\,\text{pp}). 这些一致的成果证实,从人类操纵中直接转移到物理机器人执行中吸取的机动前科。

blocks.en: Notably, while easy tasks benefit most when scaling from 30.5 ​ k 30.5\text{k} to 60.6 ​ k 60.6\text{k} total hours, gains on hard tasks begin to plateau under standard data-proportional sampling, where human clips constitute roughly 76 % 76\% of the training mixture. To test whether this plateau stems from diluted embodiment-specific supervision, we evaluate a robot-balanced configuration at the 60.6 ​ k 60.6\text{k} -hour scale that enforces a 1 : 1 1{:}1 ratio of robot and human samples in every training batch. Holding the data budget fixed, robot-balanced sampling boosts hard-task success from 19.0 % 19.0\% to 27.0 % 27.0\% ( + 8.0 ​ pp +8.0\,\text{pp} ). This result indicates that while massive human data provide broad interaction priors, preserving sufficient batch exposure to robot trajectories is crucial for executing more demanding multi-step or precision-critical skills.
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,虽然在将总时数从30.5k 30.5\text{k}缩放到60.6k 60.6\text{k}时,容易完成的任务受益最大,但根据标准的数据比例抽样,艰苦任务的收益开始趋于平稳,其中人类剪辑约占培训混合物的76%。 为了测试这个高地是否源于被稀释的特有化身监督,我们在60.6 k 60.6\text{k}上评价一个机器人平衡的配置. - 执行每批训练中机器人和人类样本比例1:1{} 持有固定的数据预算,机器人平衡的采样将硬任务的成功率从19.0% 19.0\%提高到27.0% 27.0\% (+ 8.0 pp + 8.0\,\text{pp}). 这一结果表明,虽然大量人类数据提供了广泛的互动前兆,但保持足够的批量接触机器人轨迹对于执行要求更高的多步或精确关键技能至关重要。

Under the standard scaling series, overall mean success across the 20 tasks increases monotonically from 20.0 % 20.0\% (robot-only) to 26.0 % 26.0\% ( + 15.9 ​ k ​ h +15.9\text{k}\,\text{h} human) and 30.5 % 30.5\% ( + 45.9 ​ k ​ h +45.9\text{k}\,\text{h} human). Partial task completion improves in tandem, with the macro-averaged progress score rising from 2.535 2.535 to 3.365 3.365 and 4.205 4.205 out of 10 10 . Equally important, hybrid scaling expands real-world task coverage : the number of tasks achieving at least one successful zero-shot rollout increases from 10 / 20 10/20 with robot-only pretraining to 14 / 20 14/20 and 16 / 20 16/20 as human experience is incorporated. Echoing our simulation findings ( Section 5.6.1 ), human data not only refine reliability on already feasible skills—such as Grasp and shake a bottle ( 60 % → 90 % 60\%\rightarrow 90\% ) and Place a block on a tray ( 10 % → 50 % 10\%\rightarrow 50\% )—but also unlock entirely new capabilities where the robot-only baseline never succeeds ( 0 % 0\% ), including Stack blocks ( 30 % 30\% ), Arrange blocks ( 20 % 20\% ), and Lift one bottle with each hand ( 30 % 30\% ).

blocks.en: Examining the per-task breakdown for the 60.6 ​ k 60.6\text{k} -hour robot-balanced model further clarifies its advantage on hard manipulation tasks. Compared with unweighted sampling at the same scale, balancing the human–robot ratio substantially improves tasks that require precise spatial alignment or bimanual coordination—such as Put a glue stick in a pen holder ( 10 % → 40 % 10\%\rightarrow 40\% ), Stack two bowls ( 0 % → 60 % 0\%\rightarrow 60\% ), and Lift one bottle with each hand ( 30 % → 60 % 30\%\rightarrow 60\% ). By preventing the large human corpus from overwhelming embodiment-specific control dynamics, balanced co-training effectively combines human-scale visual-semantic diversity with high-precision robotic execution.
blocks.zh: 检查60.6 k 60.6\text{k} 的每个任务分解 - 小时机器人平衡模型进一步澄清了它在硬操作任务上的优势. 与同一规模的未加权采样相比,平衡人-机器人比大大改进了需要精确空间对接或双人协调的任务,如将胶棒放入笔柄(10%-40%-右侧40-%),堆起两碗(0%-60%-右侧60-%),并用每只手举起一瓶(30%-60%-30-右侧60-%). 通过防止大型人体压倒性地表现特定控制动力,平衡的协同训练有效地结合了人尺度的视觉-语义多样性和高精度的机器人处决.

Each row pairs the inference-time goal image (left) with four head-camera keyframes from the resulting zero-shot execution (right), showing the initial scene, two intermediate interaction stages, and the final state. The examples span object transport and placement, coordinated bimanual manipulation, object reordering, and multi-step tool/container interactions.

blocks.en: Figure 22 visualizes representative zero-shot rollouts across eight real-world tasks. Beyond matching the terminal object arrangement depicted in the goal image, the policy exhibits purposeful intermediate behaviors that are not explicitly specified in the static visual goal—such as reorienting a pen holder prior to inserting a glue stick (row e) and coordinating both arms to swap or distribute objects without collision (rows b, f, h). These qualitative trajectories complement our quantitative metrics, demonstrating that HumanWAM-Goal translates static goal context into coherent, multi-step physical interactions out of the box.
blocks.zh: 图22可视化了代表性零射出8个现实世界任务. 除了与目标图像中描绘的终端对象安排相匹配外,政策还展现了静态视觉目标中未明确规定的有目的的中间行为——例如,在插入粘结棒(row e)之前调整笔接者的方向并协调双臂以互换或无相撞地分配物体(rows b, f, h). 这些质的轨迹补充了我们的量的度量,表明HumanWAM-Goal将静态目标背景转化为箱外连贯多步骤的物理互动.

blocks.en: 6.3 In-Context Learning with Visual Goals
blocks.zh: 6.3 与视觉目标挂钩的学习

blocks.en: Whereas Section 6.2 evaluates whether pretrained capabilities transfer directly to unseen tasks, we now examine a complementary question: can a single policy with strictly frozen parameters dynamically alter its execution trajectory when the desired outcome is modified purely through inference-time visual context? We evaluate this form of embodied in-context learning (ICL) by conditioning the same checkpoint on alternative goal images from identical initial scenes—varying target locations, category-to-container assignments, or stacking orders. We first verify that goal-responsive behavior emerges directly from co-training, then show that it scales to complex, multi-decision workflows after task-specific post-training, and finally demonstrate cross-embodiment ICL using egocentric human goal images.
blocks.zh: 第6.2节评价预先训练的能力是否直接转移到看不见的任务,我们现在审查一个补充问题:当所期望的结果完全通过推断时间的视觉背景加以修改时,严格冻结参数的单一政策能否动态地改变其执行轨迹? 我们通过在相同的初始场景——变化的目标地点、类别到集装箱的任务或堆放命令——的替代目标图像上设置相同的检查站来评价这种形式内涵的文字学习。 我们首先验证目标响应行为直接从共同训练中出现,然后显示它在任务特定后训练后,缩放到复杂,多决定的工作流程,最后用以自我为中心的人类目标图像来演示交叉表现ICL.

blocks.en: We first probe visual goal conditioning in the co-trained checkpoint without any target-task post-training. Figure 23 compares two rollouts initialized from the same tabletop scene containing colored blocks, conditioned on visual goals that specify distinct destinations for a bottle. Keeping all policy weights fixed, switching the goal image steers the robot to place the bottle either on the tabletop in front of the green block (panel a) or atop the elevated purple block (panel b). While fine-grained release stability on the elevated block remains imperfect without task-specific adaptation, these rollouts confirm that spatial goal grounding is already present out of the box after hybrid pretraining.
blocks.zh: 我们首先在联合训练的检查站 探测视觉射入目标 没有任何目标任务训练 图23比较了两个从同一桌面场景中初始推出的包含有色块,以指定一瓶不同目的地的可视目标为条件. 保持所有政策权重的固定,切换入门图像会引导机器人将瓶子放入绿地块前的平板上(平板A)或高地紫地块(平板B). 虽然高地块上的精细放出稳定性仍然不完善,而没有针对具体任务的调整,但这些推出证实,在混合预训后,空间目标地面已经存在出框.

blocks.en: Figure 23 : Visual goal conditioning in pretrained HumanWAM-Goal. Each panel pairs the inference-time goal image (left) with synchronized first-person and third-person keyframes (right). Without target-task post-training or parameter updates, changing the visual goal directs the policy to place the bottle (a) on the tabletop in front of the green block or (b) atop the large purple block.
blocks.zh: 图23:预训HumanWAM-Goal中的视觉入球条件. 每个面板将推断-时间目标图像(左)与同步第一人称和第三人称键框(右)相配. 在没有目标任务后训练或参数更新的情况下,改变可视目标指示政策,将瓶子(a)放入绿地块前的桌子上或(b)放入大紫地块.

blocks.en: We next evaluate whether goal-conditioned steerability is preserved—and extended to multi-step, compositional decisions—after adapting the co-trained checkpoint on task-specific demonstrations. Crucially, once post-training concludes, policy parameters remain frozen across all evaluations; behavioral changes arise solely from the supplied goal image.
blocks.zh: 接下来,我们评估在调整共同训练的检查站,使之适应具体任务示威之后,是否保留了目标可控性,并扩大到多步骤、组成决定。 关键是,一旦培训结束后,所有评价的政策参数仍然被冻结;行为变化完全来自所提供的目标形象。

blocks.en: Figure 24 : Goal-based in-context learning after post-training for tabletop sorting and stacking. Each panel pairs a supplied goal image (left, blue border) with eight chronological third-person frames (right, read left-to-right across the top then bottom row; green border marks the final state). The goals specify (a) sorting toy cars into the blue bin, plush toys into the white bin, and stacking books near the table center with the green book on top; (b) swapping the toy-to-bin assignments; and (c) retaining the original toy assignments while placing the purple book on top of a stack shifted toward the white bin.

blocks.en: Figure 24 evaluates a post-trained policy on a multi-object tabletop organization task under three distinct visual goals. Rather than memorizing a single canonical sorting routine, the frozen policy parses multiple compositional constraints from the goal image within each rollout: it reverses category-to-bin assignments when the destinations of toy cars and plush toys are swapped (panel a vs. panel b), and it modifies both the stacking order (green vs. purple book on top) and the spatial placement of the book stack when prompted by panel c. Visual goal conditioning thus scales beyond single-target localization to coordinate multiple object-level decisions over extended manipulation horizons.

In panels (a, b), the visual goal dictates which drawer of a cabinet holds a tape roll and tape measure; to satisfy the goal, the policy selectively pulls open either the upper or the middle drawer before inserting both items. blocks.en: Because HumanWAM-Goal is co-trained on heterogeneous human and robot corpora within a unified visuomotor framework, we hypothesize that it learns an embodiment-agnostic representation of scene structure and manipulation outcomes. To test this hypothesis directly, we supply the post-trained robot policy with egocentric human goal images —in which human hands, rather than robot grippers, are visible alongside the desired object configuration—and evaluate whether the robot can ground and execute the specified arrangement without parameter updates.
blocks.zh: 由于HumanWAM-Goal在一个统一的维乌莫托尔框架内,对异形人和机器人蝎子进行了共同训练,我们假设它学习了场景结构和操纵结果的化身-不可知论表现. 为了直接测试这个假说,我们向经过训练的后机器人政策提供以自我为中心的人类目标图像——在这种图像中,人类的手,而不是机器人抓取手,可以和理想的物体配置一起被看到——并评价机器人是否能够在没有参数更新的情况下地面和执行指定的安排.

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 26 , despite the visual domain gap and the presence of human hands in the conditioning images, the policy accurately interprets the underlying spatial relations and adapts its execution across both paired comparisons: it slots the brown notebook into either the rightmost or leftmost compartment before arranging the white notebooks (panels a vs. b), and it caps the mug before transporting it to either the monitor or the file rack (panels c vs. d). These results are consistent with the hypothesis that human–robot co-training facilitates the transfer of goal semantics across embodiments.

blocks.en: 6.4 Long-Horizon Execution
blocks.zh: 6.4 长视距处决

blocks.en: While the paired-goal comparisons in Section 6.3 isolate immediate responsiveness to visual context, real-world deployment often requires chaining diverse manipulation skills over extended horizons. In such settings, each action alters the scene state for subsequent subgoals, requiring the policy to transition smoothly across subtasks without disturbing previously completed arrangements. We evaluate HumanWAM-Goal after task-specific post-training across two representative long-horizon workflows: multi-stage desk organization within a shared tabletop workspace and mobile household tidying across multiple work areas.

blocks.en: Figure 28 extends evaluation from a stationary tabletop to room-scale mobile manipulation on Astribot S1. Within a single uninterrupted sequence, the policy sorts toys into bins and stacks books at the main table (keyframes 01–08), navigates to a side table to collect and discard two plastic bottles into a waste bin (09–15), traverses to two chairs to gather deformable garments into a laundry hamper (16–27), and finally returns to the organized tabletop (28). blocks.en: 7 Related Work
blocks.zh: 7 相关工作

blocks.en: 7.1 World Action Models
blocks.zh: 7.1 世界行动模式

blocks.en:
World–action models couple visual dynamics prediction with action generation, allowing robot policies to inherit manipulation priors from pretrained video models [ 57 , 65 ] .
DreamZero [ 65 ] learns control through joint video–action modeling, while LingBot-VA [ 26 ] integrates frame prediction and policy execution within an autoregressive diffusion framework.
The role of future visual information in action prediction remains an important architectural consideration [ 56 , 70 ] .
Fast-WAM [ 67 ] retains video prediction during training but omits future video generation during inference.
OpenWAM [ 56 ] systematically studies world–action information flow and embodied pretraining, demonstrating the benefits of explicit world-to-action interaction and synchronized joint denoising.
InternW0- Δ \Delta [ 34 ] instead uses training-only future supervision to learn predictive representations for action generation without video rollout during inference.
Extending world–action modeling to compositional manipulation, ViGAR [ 18 ] combines visual subgoal planning with goal-conditioned execution.
Our work complements these architectural developments by studying the effects of egocentric data scaling across different world–action configurations.
blocks.zh:
世界-动作模型将视觉动态预测与动作生成结合,使机器人政策能够继承预先训练的视频模型中的操纵前科[57,65].
DreamZero [65] 通过视频-行动联合模型学习控制,而LingBot-VA [26] 将帧预测和政策执行整合在一个自旋传播框架内.
未来视觉信息在动作预测中的作用仍然是一个重要的建筑考虑[56,70].
Fast-WAM [67] 在训练期间保留了视频预测,但在推断时省略了未来的视频生成.
OpenWAM [56] 系统研究世界-行动信息流动和体现的预训,展示明确世界-行动互动和同步联合发号施令的好处.
InternW0-Q-\Delta [34] 取而代之的是,在推论期间,只使用训练式的未来监督来学习动作生成的预测性表述,而不用视频展开.
ViGAR [18] 将世界行动模式扩大到构成操纵,将视觉次级目标规划与目标有条件的执行结合起来。
我们的工作通过研究以自我为中心的数据在不同的世界行动结构中扩展的影响来补充这些建筑发展。

blocks.en: 7.2 Pure Egocentric Pretraining
blocks.zh: 7.2 纯爱中心 预 训

blocks.en:
Pretraining on human manipulation provides visual representations and action priors for robot learning before embodiment-specific adaptation [ 36 , 22 ] .
Being-H0 [ 31 ] develops human-motion pretraining for dexterous manipulation, while EgoScale [ 73 ] scales action-labeled egocentric pretraining to over 20,000 hours and reports a log-linear relationship between data scale and validation loss.
EgoScale subsequently introduces aligned human–robot mid-training to facilitate embodiment transfer.
HumanScale [ 33 ] establishes an empirical scaling law relating egocentric pretraining hours to validation action loss after robot post-training and finds that human data can outperform robot data at matched pretraining durations.
Dyna-2 [ 14 ] extends human-video pretraining to one million hours, reporting scaling in zero-shot action prediction on unseen robot data alongside improvements in post-trained robot task performance.
Building on these findings, Open-HumanScale systematically evaluates egocentric scaling through closed-loop policy success under both in-distribution and out-of-distribution conditions.
Beyond data duration, our controlled comparisons establish diversity as an additional scaling dimension and quantify gains in the sample efficiency of robot adaptation.
blocks.zh:
关于人类操纵的先入为主的培训为机器人在具体化适应之前的学习提供了视觉表现和行动前科[36,22].
Being-H0 [31] 开发了人-运动前训练来进行 dexterous的操控,而"Ego Scale [73]"则将以行动标记的自负为中心先训练到2万多小时,并报告数据尺度和验证损失之间的对数线关系.
Ego比例表随后引入了对齐的人力-机器人中期训练,以方便化身的转移.
人类规模[33]确立了一个经验性的缩放法,将自我中心训练前时间与机器人训练后验证动作损失联系起来,并发现人类数据可以在相匹配的训练前时间里超过机器人数据.
Dyna-2 [14] 将人-视频预训扩展至一百万小时,报告在零镜头动作预测中放大了未见的机器人数据,同时改进了训练后的机器人任务性能.
在这些结论的基础上,开放的人类规模通过在分配和分配之外的条件下的封闭式扩展政策成功系统地评价自我中心。
在数据持续时间之外,我们控制下的比较将多样性确定为机器人适应样本效率的一个额外尺度并量化收益。

blocks.en: 7.3 Zero-Shot Generalization and In-Context Learning
blocks.zh: 7.3 零热通俗化和内容内学习

blocks.en:
Generalist robot policies increasingly extend beyond task-specific adaptation toward direct execution in unfamiliar tasks, environments, and embodiments [ 21 , 65 ] .
Contextual guidance provides a complementary mechanism for specifying unfamiliar behaviors without task-specific parameter updates. π 0.7 \pi_{0.7} [ 42 ] incorporates language, behavioral metadata, and visual subgoals into multimodal prompts, enabling compositional generalization and flexible control over task execution.
Demonstration-based in-context learning additionally conditions behavior on examples and interaction history [ 16 , 28 ] .
RoboICL [ 28 ] combines demonstration context with accumulated interaction memory while keeping model parameters fixed.
Our HumanWAM-Goal experiments connect these capabilities to the scale of human experience.
With robot training data held fixed, we quantify the effect of increasing egocentric data on zero-shot robot performance and qualitatively evaluate visual-goal conditioning before and after robot post-training.
blocks.zh:
通用机器人政策日益超越针对特定任务的适应,而是在不熟悉的任务、环境和表现中直接执行[21、65]。
上下文指导提供了一种补充机制,在未对特定任务参数进行更新的情况下,对不熟悉的行为进行具体说明. • 0.7\pi_{0.7}[42] 将语言、行为元数据和视觉次级目标纳入多模式提示中,从而能够对任务执行进行组成概括和灵活控制。
基于演示的内文学习在实例和互动历史上附加了行为条件[16,28].
RoboICL [28] 结合了演示上下文和累积的相互作用内存,同时保持模型参数固定.
我们人类WAM-目标实验将这些能力与人类经验的规模联系起来.
随着机器人训练数据的固定,我们量化了增加以自我为中心的数据对零镜头机器人性能的影响,并对机器人训练后前后的视觉目标条件进行质量评价。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: We presented Open-HumanScale, a fully open recipe for scaling robot learning with egocentric human experience. Our study of pure egocentric pretraining from 100 to 50,000 hours reveals an empirical log-linear scaling law in downstream out-of-distribution success. Expanding task and scene diversity strengthens this scaling trend, while larger-scale pretraining improves the sample efficiency of robot adaptation. Controlled experiments further demonstrate the value of human motion prediction and cross-source action alignment. Following this recipe, HumanWAM-Vanilla achieves competitive performance in simulation and improved robustness to visual distribution shifts on physical robots after robot post-training. Our release of annotated data, training code, checkpoints, and evaluation protocols provides a reproducible foundation for further research on egocentric scaling.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个开放的人类规模, 一个完全开放的食谱, 以自我为中心的人类经验来推广机器人的学习。 我们对100至5万小时纯自我中心预训的研究 揭示出下游分配成功 的经验性对数线缩放法 扩大任务和场景多样性会强化这种规模化趋势,而更大规模的预训则会提高机器人适应的样本效率. 被控制的实验进一步证明了人类运动预测和跨源动作对接的价值. 根据这一配方,HumanWAM-Vanilla在模拟中实现了竞争性能,并改进了自强性,在机器人训练后在物理机器人上进行视觉分配转移. 我们公布附加说明的数据、培训守则、检查站和评价协议,为进一步研究自我中心规模提供了可复制的基础。

blocks.en: HumanWAM-Goal extends this exploration to joint human–robot co-training with visual-goal conditioning, improving zero-shot transfer in simulation and achieving state-of-the-art average success on RoboTwin 2.0. On physical robots, hybrid scaling with robot-balanced sampling boosts zero-shot success and expands task coverage without target-task demonstrations. Visual goals also enable embodied in-context learning with frozen parameters, steering policies across spatial and compositional variations as well as cross-embodiment human goal images after post-training. Finally, post-trained policies support coherent subgoal chaining across long-horizon desk organization and room-scale mobile household tidying.
blocks.zh: HumanWAM-Goal将这一探索扩展到了人类-机器人联合训练与视觉-目标条件,改进了模拟中的零射入射,并实现了RoboTwin 2.0上最先进的平均成功. 在物理机器人上,与机器人平衡采样相混合的缩放能促进零射成功并扩展任务覆盖范围而无需进行目标任务演示. 视觉目标还能够以被冻结的参数进行内在的文字学习,指导跨越空间和构成变化的政策,以及培训后交叉表现人类目标图像。 最后,经过培训后的政策支持在长期办公桌组织和室内流动家庭整顿方面建立连贯的分目标链。

blocks.en: 9 Prompts for Goal Image Synthesis and Review
blocks.zh: 9 目标图像综合和审查提示

blocks.en: RoboTwin provides no reference goal images, so we synthesize one head-camera goal image for each scene. The only scene-specific inputs are the initial head-camera observation and the task instruction; no expert trajectory, terminal frame, or simulator state is used. Synthesis has two stages: a grounding stage localizes the task-relevant objects in the initial image, and an editing stage turns the initial observation into a completed-task observation. Each newly generated evaluation goal image is then reviewed and, if necessary, repaired.

blocks.en: For each of the 50 RoboTwin tasks, we manually wrote one reference annotation on a reference scene. It lists the objects (identifier, description, bounding box, and whether the object moves or stays fixed), a natural-language description of the required final state, and visual acceptance checks. A few tasks also include optional geometric guides: hinge anchor lines for articulated objects, final-extent outlines, relocation cut-outs, or edit masks. These 50 annotations are fixed across all experiments; Stage 1 adapts them to each new scene.

REGISTERED geometry overlay : exactly the same initial head image at exactly the same pixel coordinates and scale as Image 1. Magenta boxes identify movable objects ; cyan boxes / lines anchor fixed objects or base edges . The boxes are initial identity bounds , NOT requested object sizes or final locations . INSTRUCTION : { instruction } GROUNDED INITIAL OBJECTS ( pixel boxes use Image 1’ s 288 x224 coordinates ): { objects } (expands to one line per object: ‘‘- ID: description; initial box [x0, y0, x1, y1].’’) REQUIRED FINAL STATE : { plan } CONSERVATION RULES : Apply the smallest physical change that satisfies the final state . Preserve camera extrinsics / intrinsics , table , background , light , object identities / materials / scale , every distractor , and fixed destination geometry . Translate / rotate only explicitly movable objects . Preserve exact object count ; remove moved objects from their old locations . Reconstruct only newly exposed surfaces , with the existing simulator style . Do not canonicalize , beautify , replace or enlarge objects to improve visibility . A broad / awkward noun in the instruction refers to the specifically identified visible object above . For articulated tasks , preserve the stationary body ’ s original projected corners and yaw . Rotate only the moving part around its existing hinge ; never swivel the whole device toward the viewer . For a press , retain the device ’ s position and orientation and show the requested arm ’ s gripper contacting the actual control specified by the current instruction . A control may face sideways ; do not add a top button or rotate the device to expose it . For a hold / lift , show a real grasp with clearance above the support ; for place / stack , show supported objects at the destination ; release only grasps no longer required by the public complete task , and retain required support - holding grasps . Preserve the two - arm robot ’ s construction , connected kinematic chains and plausible reach . An idle arm can stay outside the head frame . Do not invent extra hands / arms or use a floating disconnected gripper . Before rendering , mentally match each ID to its original instance , distinguish movable and fixed parts , and check count , final relation , support / contact and stationary edges . Occlusion is natural : do not move fixed objects or change the camera just to reveal them . Output only the completed scene , at the exact aspect ratio and padding of Image 1. No goal image or future state is provided . GEOMETRY PRIORITY : Image 1 is already the requested 1152 x896 output size . Edit it in place : preserve unedited pixels and their exact coordinates . Image 3 aligns pixel - for - pixel with it . Do not reframe , regenerate or regularize the scene . Object boxes above use native coordinates : multiply by FOUR for input / output pixels . Preserve actual object dimensions under the fixed camera and perspective . Do not shrink targets to fit destinations or shrink whole stacks . Move targets with their original shape / volume . Preserve the named arm ’ s mechanical identity and its connection to its original fixed mount . An arm may reach across the table ; target position and the edge where a cropped gripper appears do not define arm identity . Do not mirror the robot or exchange arms . [ final - extent guides ] Image 3 also includes ORANGE final - extent guides : a manually proposed geometric layout derived from initial object dimensions and the instruction , NOT an observed future image . Match the original object ’ s size and shape within this guide at its destination . These outlines are approximate projections , never additional objects . Remove all guide lines / text from the output . Do not treat an orange guide as an initial object or duplicate the target . [ relocation guides ] IMPORTANT IMAGE -3 SIZE / POSE GUIDE : the orange - outlined target at the destination is an exact unscaled cutout of the initial object , translated to propose the final placement . It is synthetic guidance from initial pixels , NOT a future observation or an additional object . This guide makes the required size and yaw explicit : match that FULL - SIZE silhouette and pose , keep the destination mat fixed underneath , and remove the old source object . Generate a coherent final scene with natural contact / shadows , without orange outlines or text . Do not shrink the target to fit inside the mat . FINAL IMAGE CHECKS -- every item must be visibly satisfied : { acceptance_checks } (expands to one bullet per check) [ edit masks ] The attached alpha mask restricts editing to transparent regions containing the old target and proposed destination . Keep opaque regions exactly unchanged . Render the completed object placement inside the editable regions ; do not move fixed supports or resize targets to fit the mask . No robot arm needs to enter a completed released - placement scene . Only after recorded compatibility review may the complete task fill in omitted steps . An explicit contradictory instruction is not an omission and must not be silently overridden . Unresolved language conflicts require review before generation . Left / right arm names refer to the robot ’ s mechanical arms and their fixed mounts , not the target ’ s horizontal image position or the edge where a cropped gripper appears . Preserve each arm ’ s connection to its own mount , including cross - table reaches ; do not mirror the robot or exchange arm identities . The appearance sheet illustrates construction only . Preserve current object identity , size and background . blocks.en: 9.4 Goal Review and Repair
blocks.zh: 9.4 目标审查和修理

blocks.en: ChatGPT Astra High reviews every newly generated evaluation goal image. For each case it sees the initial and generated head images at native resolution, the instruction, the public task description, and the Stage-1 grounding. It treats the grounding as fallible and locates objects independently in the initial image, then returns pass , fail , or uncertain with case-specific evidence. The review rubric is:
blocks.zh: 聊天游戏 阿斯特拉语Name 高评价每个新产生的评价目标图像。 对于每个案例,它都从原生分辨率、指令、公共任务说明和阶段一的地基上看到初始和生成的头像。 它将地平板视为可谬误,并在初始图像中独立定位对象,然后返回通过,失败,或不确定具体案件的证据. 评论题目是:

blocks.en: ⬇ Check target / destination identity , exact instructed goal relation / arm when visually distinguishable , source removal / object counts , appearance / size , fixed background / destination / camera , real grasp / contact / support , articulated hinge , and coherent robot . Public full task only fills omissions compatibly , never overrides explicit instruction . Natural occlusion is legitimate . Do not demand an entire trajectory in a single goal frame , invent new acceptance rules , equate image - side with mechanical arm , or mark all cropped mounts uncertain . Pass means visible state is consistent with no clear defect ; fail means concrete visible contradiction ; uncertain identifies concrete unresolved evidence . The audit concerns whether the visible generated goal is compatible with the exact task under the fixed head camera ; it does NOT establish hidden physical state or execution history . If the requested endpoint is naturally outside the view or inside a clipped container , all relevant visible changes and fixed geometry are consistent , and no visible contradiction exists , use pass with an explicit visibility limitation . Retain uncertain when there is a specific visible ambiguity ( which physical object , actual contact , orientation , scale ) rather than merely unverifiable hidden physics .
blocks.zh: ⬇ 检查目标/目的身份, 精确指示的目标关系/ 手臂, 当可视辨别时, 源清除/ 对象计数, 外观/ 大小, 固定背景/ 目的/ 相机, 真实的抓取/ 联系/ 支持, 清晰的链条, 以及连贯的机器人 。 公开的完整任务只能以相容的方式填充遗漏,绝不凌驾于明确的指令之上. 自然隔离是合法的。 不要要求在一个单一的入球框内有整个轨迹, 发明新的接受规则, Pass表示可见状态与没有明显的缺陷一致; 审计涉及可见生成的目标是否与固定头相机下的确切任务相容;它没有建立隐藏的物理状态或执行历史. 如果请求的终点自然在视图之外或被剪接的容器内,所有相关的可见变化和固定几何都一致,而且不存在明显的自相矛盾之处,则使用具有明显可见度限制的通行证。 当存在具体可见的模糊性(哪个物理物体,实际接触,方向,尺度),而不仅仅是无法验证的隐藏物理时,保持不确定性.

blocks.en: Each non-passing verdict (fail or uncertain) comes with repair feedback and a repair stage. If the grounding misidentified the source, receiver, or contact region, the reviewer supplies a corrected target from the initial image and Stage 1 is rerun with this feedback. Otherwise, Stage 2 is rerun with the feedback inserted before the task block, and the grounding is kept. Every replacement image is reviewed again. Regenerated images are judged under a looser criterion than first-pass images: the reviewer accepts reasonable perspective variation and mild size differences that can be explained by projection, but still rejects wrong targets or receivers, duplicated or missing objects, wrong task relations, severe deformation, invented fixtures, and disconnected or extra arms.
blocks.zh: 每一个非通过判决(失败或不确定)都伴随着修理反馈和修理阶段. 如果搁浅错误地识别出源,接收者,或联系区域,审查者会从初始图像中提供一个被更正的目标,而第1阶段则会随此反馈重新运行. 否则,第2阶段将重新运行,在任务块前插入反馈,并保留地基. 每个替换图像都会再次被审查. 再生成的图像比先行图像更宽松的标准判断:审查者接受合理的视角变异和轻度的大小差异,这些差异可以通过投影来解释,但仍拒绝错误的目标或接收器,重复或缺失的对象,错误的任务关系,严重变形,发明了固定装置,以及断开或多余的武器.

blocks.en: Of the 7,032 evaluation goal images newly generated with this pipeline, 6,380 (90.7%) passed the first review, 542 (7.7%) failed, and 110 (1.6%) were uncertain (Table 15 ). After repair, all 7,032 passed review; repaired images were judged under the looser criterion described above. The review checks visual and instructional consistency only; it does not verify physical feasibility or task success in simulation. The remaining 2,968 of the 10,000 evaluation goals are earlier images that a separate audit approved for reuse.
blocks.zh: 在利用这一管道新产生的7 032个评价目标图像中,6 380个(90.7%)通过了第一次审查,542个(7.7%)失败,110个(1.6%)不确定(表15)。 修复后,7,032人全部通过审查;被修复的图像根据上述更松散的标准判断. 审查只检查视觉和教学的一致性;它不核查模拟的实际可行性或任务成功。 在10 000个评价目标中,其余的2 968个是较早的图像,即批准再利用的单独审计。

blocks.en: Table 16 specifies the 20 real-world tasks and their scoring rubrics. Each checkpoint is evaluated on 10 trials per task (200 rollouts), without target-task demonstrations or parameter updates. Tasks are specified by goal images with the shared instruction “Complete the task shown in the goal image.”
blocks.zh: 表16列出了20项现实世界任务及其分数。 每个检查站对每项任务的10起审判(200起)进行评估,没有目标任务示范或参数更新。 任务由目标图像指定,共享指令“完成目标图像中显示的任务。 “

blocks.en: Each task has three or four scored milestones. Parenthesized values are maximum stage scores and sum to 10; intermediate scores retain the partial credit recorded during evaluation. Binary success is assessed separately using the task outcome in the last column, and need not imply a score of 10. For example, the records deduct one point for using a different arm from the goal image (E1), and one or two points for a tipped cup or a lid grasp, respectively (H3), despite marking these trials successful. Both metrics are averaged over trials and then equally over tasks.
blocks.zh: 每个任务都有三到四个得分的里程碑. 亲和值是最高阶段分数,总和为10;中间分数保留评价期间记录的部分信用. 二进制成功率使用上一栏的任务结果单独评估,无需表示得分为10分. 例如,记录从目标图像(E1)中扣除了使用不同臂的一分,从被倾覆的杯子或盖子(H3)中扣除了一分或两分,尽管这些试验都取得了成功。 这两个衡量标准在审判中平均,在任务中平均。
